structure:Code.common:Name: Investment income on income payable on pension entitlements
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment income on income payable on pension entitlements.

structure:Code.common:Name: Investment income on income attributable to investment fund shareholders (investment income)
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment income on income attributable to investment fund shareholders (investment income).

structure:Code.common:Name: Investment income, income on investment income attributable to investment fund shareholders, dividends (investment income)
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment income, income on investment income attributable to investment fund shareholders, dividends (investment income).

structure:Code.common:Name: Investment income on reinvested earnings (investment income)
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment income on reinvested earnings (investment income).

structure:Code.common:Name: Investment income on equity and investment fund shares
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment income on equity and investment fund shares.

structure:Code.common:Name: Investment income on income attributable to policy holders (insurance, pension and standardized guarantee schemes)
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment income on income attributable to policy holders (insurance, pension and standardized guarantee schemes).

structure:Code.common:Name: Investment income on rent
structure:Code.common:Description: Income receivable by the owner of a non-produced natural resource or another non-produced nonfinancial asset (the lessor or landlord) for putting the asset at the disposal of another institutional unit (a lessee or tenant) for use in production.

structure:Code.common:Name: Investment income on other primary income
structure:Code.common:Description: Primary incomes are incomes earned by institutional units as a consequence of their involvement in processes of production or ownership of assets that may be needed for purposes of production.

structure:Code.common:Name: Investment income on other investment income
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment income on other investment income.

structure:Code.common:Name: Investment income on interest and income attributable to policy holders
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment income on interest and income attributable to policy holders.

structure:Code.common:Name: Investment income on investment income attributable to shareholders, including income on IF, including RIE
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment income on investment income attributable to shareholders, including income on IF, including RIE.

structure:Code.common:Name: Current taxes on income, wealth, etc.
structure:Code.common:Description: Taxes which mainly consist of taxes on the incomes of households or profits of corporations and of taxes on wealth that are payable regularly every tax period (as distinct from capital taxes levied infrequently). In the external accounts, current taxes on income, wealth, etc., consist mainly of taxes levied on the income earned by nonresidents from the provision of their labor or financial assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Taxes on income
structure:Code.common:Description: Taxes payable on incomes, profits, and capital gains.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other current taxes excluding on income
structure:Code.common:Description: Current taxes on income, wealth, etc. excluding the taxes on income, profits, and capital gains.

structure:Code.common:Name: Current taxes on income, wealth, etc. of which: payable by border, seasonal, and other short-term workers (current taxes on income, wealth, etc.)
structure:Code.common:Description: Income and wealth taxes specifically related to individuals working across borders on a seasonal or short-term basis.

structure:Code.common:Name: Social contributions and benefits
structure:Code.common:Description: Social contributions are actual and imputed contributions payable to social insurance schemes in order for a designated beneficiary to be entitled to receive the social benefits covered by the scheme, and social benefits are current transfers receivable by households intended to provide for the needs that arise from certain events or circumstances, for example, sickness, unemployment, retirement, housing, education or family circumstances.

structure:Code.common:Name: Social contributions
structure:Code.common:Description: Actual and imputed contributions payable to social insurance schemes in order for a designated beneficiary to be entitled to receive the social benefits covered by the scheme.

structure:Code.common:Name: Employers' actual social contributions
structure:Code.common:Description: Actual contributions payable by employers to social security funds and other social insurance schemes, to obtain entitlement to social benefits for their employees.

structure:Code.common:Name: Employers' actual pension contributions
structure:Code.common:Description: Payments made by employers into pension schemes on behalf of their employees for future retirement benefits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Employers' actual non-pension contributions
structure:Code.common:Description: Payments made by employers for benefits other than pensions, such as health insurance or unemployment insurance, that are not deferred to a future date.

structure:Code.common:Name: Employers' imputed social contributions
structure:Code.common:Description: Imputed contributions payable by employers in order to deliver non-pension social benefits paid directly by employers to their employees, ex-employees and other eligible persons, and pension benefits under a defined benefit pension scheme. It is calculated as a residual after accounting for employers' and households' actual contributions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Households' actual social contributions
structure:Code.common:Description: Social contributions payable on their own behalf by employees or self-employed persons, which may include persons temporarily without employment, to social insurance schemes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Households actual pension contributions
structure:Code.common:Description: Contributions made by households into pension schemes for future retirement benefits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Households actual non-pension contributions
structure:Code.common:Description: Contributions made by households for non-pension benefits, such as health insurance or savings plans, that are not deferred to a future date.

structure:Code.common:Name: Social contributions payable by border, seasonal, and other short-term workers
structure:Code.common:Description: Social contributions payable by border, seasonal, and other short-term workers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Social benefits
structure:Code.common:Description: Current transfers receivable by households intended to provide for the needs that arise from certain events or circumstances, for example, sickness, unemployment, retirement, housing, education, or family circumstances.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other social allowances (payments of family, education, medical services and other allowances) excluding retirement and survivors' pensions
structure:Code.common:Description: Other social allowances (payments of family, education, medical services and other allowances) excluding retirement and survivors' pensions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Retirement and survivors' pensions
structure:Code.common:Description: Retirement and survivors' pensions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Social transfers in kind
structure:Code.common:Description: Goods and services provided to households by government and NPISHs either free or at prices that are not economically significant.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other current transfers
structure:Code.common:Description: All current transfers other than current taxes on income, wealth, etc., social contributions and social benefits, and social transfers in kind. In the external accounts, all current transfers other than personal transfers are included in other current transfers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net non-life insurance premiums
structure:Code.common:Description: The sum of actual non-life insurance (or reinsurance) premiums payable by policyholders to obtain insurance cover during the accounting period (actual premiums earned) and the premium supplements payable out of the investment income attributed to insurance policyholders less the service charges payable to the insurance corporation.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net non-life direct insurance premiums (net of claims)
structure:Code.common:Description: Net non-life direct insurance premiums (net of claims).

structure:Code.common:Name: Net non-life reinsurance premiums
structure:Code.common:Description: Net non-life reinsurance premiums.

structure:Code.common:Name: Nonlife insurance claims
structure:Code.common:Description: The amounts payable in settlement of injuries or damages that result from an event covered by the nonlife insurance (or reinsurance) policy occurring in the period for which the policy is valid. In the case of major catastrophic events, some proportion of the claims may be recorded as capital transfers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Non-life direct insurance claims
structure:Code.common:Description: Non-life direct insurance claims.

structure:Code.common:Name: Non-life reinsurance claims
structure:Code.common:Description: Non-life reinsurance claims.

structure:Code.common:Name: Current transfers within general government
structure:Code.common:Description: Current transfers between different government units, such as frequently occur between central and state or local government units, and between general government and social security funds.

structure:Code.common:Name: Secondary income: Current international cooperation
structure:Code.common:Description: Current transfers in cash or in kind between the governments of different countries or between governments and international organizations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Secondary income: o/w exceptional financing (memo item)
structure:Code.common:Description: Secondary income: o/w exceptional financing (memo item).

structure:Code.common:Name: Secondary income: grants received from IMF subsidy accounts (memo item: o/w exceptional financing), secondary income
structure:Code.common:Description: Secondary income: Grants received from IMF subsidy accounts (memo item: o/w exceptional financing), secondary income.

structure:Code.common:Name: Secondary income: other intergovernmental grants (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Secondary income: Other intergovernmental grants (memo item: o/w exceptional financing).

structure:Code.common:Name: Secondary income: current international cooperation involving the EU institutions
structure:Code.common:Description: Secondary income: Current international cooperation involving the EU institutions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Secondary income: current international cooperation - European development fund
structure:Code.common:Description: Secondary income: Current international cooperation - European development fund.

structure:Code.common:Name: Secondary income: current international cooperation - European social fund
structure:Code.common:Description: Secondary income: Current international cooperation - European social fund.

structure:Code.common:Name: Secondary income: current international cooperation - agriculture and fish (guidance and other)
structure:Code.common:Description: Secondary income: Current international cooperation - agriculture and fish (guidance and other).

structure:Code.common:Name: Secondary income: current international cooperation - European regional development fund
structure:Code.common:Description: Secondary income: Current international cooperation - European regional development fund.

structure:Code.common:Name: Secondary income: current international cooperation - European community steel and coal transfers
structure:Code.common:Description: Secondary income: Current international cooperation - European community steel and coal transfers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Secondary income: current international cooperation - other
structure:Code.common:Description: Secondary income: Current international cooperation - other.

structure:Code.common:Name: Secondary income: current international cooperation other
structure:Code.common:Description: Secondary income: Current international cooperation other.

structure:Code.common:Name: Miscellaneous current transfers
structure:Code.common:Description: Miscellaneous current transfers include all current transfers, in cash or in kind, other than personal transfers, current taxes on income, wealth, etc.; social contributions less service charges and social benefits; nonlife insurance premiums less service charges and nonlife insurance claims; and current international cooperation.

structure:Code.common:Name: Current transfers to NPISH
structure:Code.common:Description: Current transfers directed towards Non-Profit Institutions Serving Households.

structure:Code.common:Name: Personal transfers (current transfers between resident and nonresident households)
structure:Code.common:Description: Personal transfers (current transfers between resident and nonresident households).

structure:Code.common:Name: Personal transfers other than workers' remittances
structure:Code.common:Description: Personal transfers other than workers' remittances.

structure:Code.common:Name: Workers' remittances
structure:Code.common:Description: Workers' remittances.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other miscellaneous current transfers
structure:Code.common:Description: Fines and penalties, payments (after deduction of service charge and donations) and receipts related to lotteries and gambling, and payments for compensation

structure:Code.common:Name: Current transfers to NPISHs: miscellaneous current transfers
structure:Code.common:Description: Various current transfers to NPISHs, encompassing a range of activities and purposes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Value added tax and gross national income-based European Union own resources
structure:Code.common:Description: Value added tax and gross national income-based European Union own resources.

structure:Code.common:Name: VAT-based third EU own resource
structure:Code.common:Description: VAT-based third EU own resource.

structure:Code.common:Name: GNI-based fourth EU own resource
structure:Code.common:Description: Contributions made by EU member states to the EU budget based on a percentage of their Gross National Income (GNI).

structure:Code.common:Name: Current transfers of which UK rebate
structure:Code.common:Description: Particular current transfers related to the UK's rebate from the EU budget.

structure:Code.common:Name: Miscellaneous non-tax contribution of the government to the institutions of the EU
structure:Code.common:Description: Miscellaneous non-tax contribution of the government to the institutions of the EU.

structure:Code.common:Name: Current international cooperation, miscellaneous current transfers (including in the EU VAT and GNI-based own resources)
structure:Code.common:Description: Current transfers related to international cooperation and miscellaneous activities, including contributions based on VAT and GNI in the EU context.

structure:Code.common:Name: All miscellaneous current transfers
structure:Code.common:Description: Current transfers that do not fit into the regular categories of the current account, encompassing a variety of one-time or irregular transactions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other current transfers: official
structure:Code.common:Description: These are transfers between governments that are not related to trade or investment.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other current transfers: private
structure:Code.common:Description: These are transfers between individuals or private entities in different countries. This can include remittances (money sent by migrant workers to their home countries), gifts, and inheritances.

structure:Code.common:Name: Adjustment for change in pension entitlements
structure:Code.common:Description: Modifications made to the accounting records to reflect changes in the value or amount of pension benefits that individuals are entitled to receive.

structure:Code.common:Name: Capital transfers
structure:Code.common:Description: Unrequited transfers, either in cash or in kind, linked to the acquisition, disposal or transfer of an asset (other than cash or inventories); or where a liability is forgiven or assumed; or where the transfers are intended to address accumulated losses incurred over a multi-year period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Capital taxes
structure:Code.common:Description: Taxes charged at irregular and infrequent intervals on the values of the assets or net worth owned by institutional units or on the values of assets transferred between institutional units as a result of legacies, gifts inter vivos, or other transfers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Investment grants
structure:Code.common:Description: Capital transfers made by governments or international organizations to other institutional units to finance all or part of the costs of their acquiring nonfinancial assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Investment grants involving EU Institutions
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment grants involving EU Institutions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Agriculture and fishery grants (EAGGF guidance and others)
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial support provided to the agriculture and fisheries sectors, including those from the European Agricultural Guidance and Guarantee Fund (EAGGF) and other sources.

structure:Code.common:Name: European regional development fund - grants
structure:Code.common:Description: Grants provided by the European Union aimed at strengthening economic and social cohesion by correcting imbalances between its regions.

structure:Code.common:Name: European development fund: EU Commission capital transfers to third countries
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial contributions from the EU Commission to non-EU countries for development purposes, funded by member states.

structure:Code.common:Name: Cohesion funds
structure:Code.common:Description: EU funds aimed at reducing economic and social disparities and promoting sustainable development across regions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Investment grants: other
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment grants: other.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other capital transfers
structure:Code.common:Description: All capital transfers except capital taxes, investment grants, and debt forgiveness.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other capital transfers: debt forgiveness
structure:Code.common:Description: Other capital transfers: debt forgiveness.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt forgiveness (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: The cancellation of debt, noted separately when associated with special financing conditions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt forgiveness granted by the IMF (other capital transfers)
structure:Code.common:Description: Specific debt forgiveness actions taken by the International Monetary Fund as part of broader capital transfers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt forgiveness, net non-debt-creating inflows (other capital transfers)
structure:Code.common:Description: Forgiveness of debt that does not create new debt obligations, categorized within other capital transfers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other capital transfers: excluding debt forgiveness
structure:Code.common:Description: Other capital transfers: excluding debt forgiveness

structure:Code.common:Name: Other capital transfers involving EU Institutions
structure:Code.common:Description: Other capital transfers involving EU Institutions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other capital transfers: agriculture and fishery (EAGGF guidance and others)
structure:Code.common:Description: Other capital transfers: agriculture and fishery (EAGGF guidance and others).

structure:Code.common:Name: Other capital transfers: other
structure:Code.common:Description: Other capital transfers: other.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other capital transfers: migrant transfers
structure:Code.common:Description: Other capital transfers: migrant transfers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other capital transfers: other
structure:Code.common:Description: Other capital transfers: other.

structure:Code.common:Name: Capital transfers grants
structure:Code.common:Description: Transfers that do not need to be repaid and are intended for financing specific capital projects or for capital assistance.

structure:Code.common:Name: Capital transfers between households
structure:Code.common:Description: Transfers of capital among households, documented separately for detailed accounting.

structure:Code.common:Name: Capital transfers to NPISH
structure:Code.common:Description: Capital transfers directed towards Non-Profit Institutions Serving Households, noted separately for accounting clarity.

structure:Code.common:Name: Capital transfers other than debt forgiveness
structure:Code.common:Description: Transfers related to the exchange of financial or physical assets, excluding those categorized as forgiveness of debt.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other investment grants (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Other investment grants (memo item: o/w exceptional financing).

structure:Code.common:Name: Capital transfers (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Capital transfers noted separately when they are part of unusual or exceptional financing arrangements.

structure:Code.common:Name: Grants received from IMF subsidy accounts (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial grants received from the International Monetary Fund, noted separately when part of special financing arrangements.

structure:Code.common:Name: Disappearing Comparative Advantage
structure:Code.common:Description: Disappearing Comparative Advantage.

structure:Code.common:Name: A generalized measure of diversity of service exporters
structure:Code.common:Description: Average ubiquity of a given service export (service specific measure).

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross external borrowing
structure:Code.common:Description: The total amount of funds borrowed from foreign sources by a country or its residents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Emerging Comparative Advantage
structure:Code.common:Description: Emerging Comparative Advantage.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net errors and omissions
structure:Code.common:Description: Stemming from imperfections in source data and compilation. In the balance of payments, it is used to show the difference between net lending/net borrowing derived from the financial account and net lending/net borrowing from the current and capital accounts.

structure:Code.common:Name: Statistical discrepancy
structure:Code.common:Description: Statistical imbalances stemming from imperfections in source data and compilation. In the balance of payments, it is used to show the difference between net lending/net borrowing derived from the financial account and net lending/net borrowing from the current and capital accounts.

structure:Code.common:Name: Statistical discrepancy between changes and stocks of reserves
structure:Code.common:Description: Statistical discrepancy between changes and stocks of reserves.

structure:Code.common:Name: Exchange rates
structure:Code.common:Description: The price of one currency in terms of another, used in converting from one currency to another in international transactions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Estimated level of reserves
structure:Code.common:Description: The projected amount of a country's international reserves, including foreign currency, gold, and other assets held by the central bank to back liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial account balance
structure:Code.common:Description: The difference between the net acquisition of financial assets and the net incurrence of liabilities resulting from transactions between residents and nonresidents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Change in foreign balances of goods and services
structure:Code.common:Description: Change in foreign balances of goods and services.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt service charges: amortization paid
structure:Code.common:Description: Payments made to cover the amortization portion of debt service charges.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt service charges: amortization paid, official
structure:Code.common:Description: Payments made to cover the amortization portion of debt service charges.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt service charges: interest paid
structure:Code.common:Description: Payments made to cover the interest components of debt service charges.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt service charges: interest and principal paid
structure:Code.common:Description: Payments made to cover both the interest and principal components of debt service charges.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt service charges: paid
structure:Code.common:Description: Total payments made to cover all components of debt service charges.

structure:Code.common:Name: External debt, Amortization paid
structure:Code.common:Description: External debt, Amortization paid.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total exceptional financing
structure:Code.common:Description: Total exceptional financing.

structure:Code.common:Name: Equity investment associated with debt reduction (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Equity investments made in the context of reducing or restructuring a country's debt, noted separately when part of special financing arrangements.

structure:Code.common:Name: Drawings on new loans/Issues of new securities by authorities or by other sectors on behalf of authorities (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: New borrowings or securities issuances by authorities, or on their behalf by other sectors, noted separately in the context of special financing.

structure:Code.common:Name: Prepayment/buyback (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Prepayment/buyback (memo item: o/w exceptional financing).

structure:Code.common:Name: Rescheduling of arrears: total (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Rescheduling of arrears: total (memo item: o/w exceptional financing).

structure:Code.common:Name: Rescheduling of arrears on principal (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Rescheduling of arrears on principal (memo item: o/w exceptional financing).

structure:Code.common:Name: Rescheduling of arrears on interest/coupon (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Rescheduling of arrears on interest/coupon (memo item: o/w exceptional financing).

structure:Code.common:Name: Accumulation of arrears: total (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: The total sum of all overdue payments including principal, interest, and penalty interest, specifically highlighted when part of unique financing solutions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Accumulation of arrears on principal (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: The total amount of principal payments that have fallen due but remain unpaid, separately recorded in the context of unusual financial arrangements.

structure:Code.common:Name: Accumulation of arrears on original interest/coupon (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: The build-up of overdue payments on the initially agreed interest or coupon payments, noted separately when related to extraordinary financing measures.

structure:Code.common:Name: Accumulation of arrears on penalty interest (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: The accumulation of overdue payments specifically on penalty interest charges, distinguished when associated with exceptional financing conditions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Repayment of arrears: total (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Repayment of arrears: total (memo item: o/w exceptional financing).

structure:Code.common:Name: Repayment of arrears on principal (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Repayment of arrears on principal (memo item: o/w exceptional financing).

structure:Code.common:Name: Repayment of arrears on interest/coupon (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Repayment of arrears on interest/coupon (memo item: o/w exceptional financing).

structure:Code.common:Name: Rescheduling of payments due in current reporting period, total (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Rescheduling of payments due in current reporting period, total (memo item: o/w exceptional financing).

structure:Code.common:Name: Rescheduling of payments due in current reporting period, on principal (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Rescheduling of payments due in current reporting period, on principal (memo item: o/w exceptional financing).

structure:Code.common:Name: Rescheduling of payments due in current reporting period, on interest/coupon (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Rescheduling of payments due in current reporting period, on interest/coupon (memo item: o/w exceptional financing).

structure:Code.common:Name: Cancellation of arrears total (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: The total elimination of all types of overdue payments, distinguished when occurring under unique financing conditions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Cancellation of arrears on principal (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: The formal elimination of overdue principal payments, specifically identified in the context of extraordinary financial measures.

structure:Code.common:Name: Cancellation of arrears on interest/coupon (memo item: o/w exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: The formal elimination of overdue interest or coupon payments, noted separately when part of special financing arrangements.

structure:Code.common:Name: Arrears not in exceptional financing (supplementary item: o/w)
structure:Code.common:Description: Overdue payments that are not part of any extraordinary financing arrangements, listed separately for clarity.

structure:Code.common:Name: Exceptional financing: arrears
structure:Code.common:Description: Financing received or recorded when a country falls behind on its payment obligations, part of special arrangements to address payment difficulties.

structure:Code.common:Name: Exceptional financing: other
structure:Code.common:Description: Other forms of financing that do not fit standard categories and are provided under special conditions to address financial needs.

structure:Code.common:Name: Exceptional financing: rescheduling
structure:Code.common:Description: The process of renegotiating the terms of debt repayment, often involving extending payment periods, under special financing conditions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial flows
structure:Code.common:Description: Movements of capital across borders in the form of investments, loans, or other transactions affecting a country's balance of payments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial flows (official)
structure:Code.common:Description: Government-related financial transactions across borders, including aid, grants, and loans from official sources.

structure:Code.common:Name: External debt
structure:Code.common:Description: Liabilities that require payment(s) of interest and/or principal by the debtor at some point(s) in the future and that are owed to nonresidents by residents of an economy.

structure:Code.common:Name: External debt: total debt service
structure:Code.common:Description: Total external debt service charges reflect the amortization (interest and regular payments) and principle payments related to gross external debt during the accounting period. Gross external debt reflects liabilities that require payment(s) of interest and/or principal by the debtor at some point(s) in the future and that are owed to non-residents by residents of an economy.

structure:Code.common:Name: External debt: total debt service, amortization
structure:Code.common:Description: Total external debt amortization charges reflect the amortization (interest and regular payments) charges related to gross external debt during the accounting period. Gross external debt reflects liabilities that require payment(s) of interest and/or principal by the debtor at some point(s) in the future and that are owed to non-residents by residents of an economy.

structure:Code.common:Name: External debt: total debt service, amortization (official)
structure:Code.common:Description: The total amount of principal repayments (amortization) due on external debt, as recorded by official sources.

structure:Code.common:Name: External debt: total debt service, amortization (private)
structure:Code.common:Description: The total amount of principal repayments (amortization) due on external debt, as recorded by private entities.

structure:Code.common:Name: External debt: total debt service, interest
structure:Code.common:Description: Total external debt interest charges reflect the interest payments related to gross external debt during the accounting period. Gross external debt reflects liabilities that require payment(s) of interest and/or principal by the debtor at some point(s) in the future and that are owed to non-residents by residents of an economy.

structure:Code.common:Name: Factor income
structure:Code.common:Description: Income earned from the factors of production, including wages for labor, interest for capital, rent for land, and profits for entrepreneurship.

structure:Code.common:Name: Goods
structure:Code.common:Description: Physical, produced objects, over which ownership rights can be established and whose ownership can be transferred from one institutional unit to another by engaging in transactions on markets.

structure:Code.common:Name: General merchandise on a balance of payments basis
structure:Code.common:Description: Goods whose economic ownership is changed between a resident and a nonresident and that are not included in the following specific categories: goods under merchanting, nonmonetary gold, and parts of travel, construction, and government goods and services n.i.e.

structure:Code.common:Name: General merchandise on a balance of payments basis, re-exports
structure:Code.common:Description: Goods that are imported into a country and then exported again without significant modification, recorded in the balance of payments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net exports of goods under merchanting
structure:Code.common:Description: The difference between sales over purchases of goods for merchanting is shown as the item “net exports of goods under merchanting.” This item includes merchants’ margins, holding gains and losses, and changes in inventories of goods under merchanting. As a result of losses or increases in inventories, net exports of goods under merchanting may be negative in some cases.

structure:Code.common:Name: Goods acquired under merchanting
structure:Code.common:Description: Goods purchased by a resident of one country from a resident of another country and sold to a third country without entering the merchant's country.

structure:Code.common:Name: Goods sold under merchanting
structure:Code.common:Description: Goods purchased and then sold by a merchant without the goods entering the merchant's country.

structure:Code.common:Name: Nonmonetary gold
structure:Code.common:Description: Gold bullion not held as reserve assets. It is a nonfinancial asset. In the national accounts, stocks and flows of nonmonetary gold are recorded in the capital account. In the external accounts, cross-border transactions are recorded in the goods account under nonmonetary gold while stocks are not recorded.

structure:Code.common:Name: Branding - quasi-transit trade adjustment
structure:Code.common:Description: Adjustments made to trade figures to account for goods that pass through a country (transit trade) but are also branded or otherwise modified, attributing some economic value to the transit country.

structure:Code.common:Name: Goods balance
structure:Code.common:Description: The difference between the value of a country's exports and imports of goods.

structure:Code.common:Name: Goods balance: oil related products
structure:Code.common:Description: This refers to the difference between the value of exports and imports of goods that are directly related to oil, such as crude oil, refined petroleum products, and petrochemicals.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gas and condensates exports
structure:Code.common:Description: The export of natural gas and condensates (light liquid hydrocarbons recovered from gas fields) to other countries.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross external financing

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross external financing needs

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross international reserves
structure:Code.common:Description: The total holdings of a country's central bank in foreign currencies, gold, and other reserve assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross official reserves
structure:Code.common:Description: The official holdings of a country's central bank in foreign currencies, gold, and other assets designated to back the country's liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Repair on goods
structure:Code.common:Description: Repair on goods.

structure:Code.common:Name: Goods and services
structure:Code.common:Description: Goods are physical, produced objects, over which ownership rights can be established and whose ownership can be transferred from one institutional unit to another by engaging in transactions on markets. Services result from a production activity that changes the conditions of the consuming units, or facilitates the exchange of products or financial assets. Services are not generally separate items over which ownership rights can be established and cannot generally be separated from their production.

structure:Code.common:Name: Goods and services balance

structure:Code.common:Name: Goods, services and primary income

structure:Code.common:Name: International investment position
structure:Code.common:Description: Statement that shows at a particular point in time the value and composition of financial assets of residents of an economy that are claims on nonresidents or are gold bullion held as reserve assets and of the liabilities of residents of an economy to nonresidents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Primary plus secondary income
structure:Code.common:Description: Primary incomes are incomes earned by institutional units as a consequence of their involvement in processes of production or ownership of assets that may be needed for purposes of production. Secondary incomes are incomes arising from the distribution of income between institutional units via current transfers. In the context of the external accounts, this account records current transfers between residents and non-residents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Primary income
structure:Code.common:Description: Primary incomes are incomes earned by institutional units as a consequence of their involvement in processes of production or ownership of assets that may be needed for purposes of production.

structure:Code.common:Name: Primary income balance
structure:Code.common:Description: Total value of the earned incomes receivable by an institutional unit or sector less the total of the earned incomes payable.

structure:Code.common:Name: Secondary income
structure:Code.common:Description: Secondary incomes are incomes arising from the distribution of income between institutional units via current transfers. In the context of the external accounts, this account records current transfers between residents and non-residents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Capital account balance
structure:Code.common:Description: The difference between the sum of disposals of nonproduced nonfinancial assets and capital transfers receivable and the sum of acquisitions of nonproduced nonfinancial assets and capital transfers payable.

structure:Code.common:Name: Capital account total
structure:Code.common:Description: The sum of all transactions recorded in the capital account, reflecting capital transfers and acquisitions/disposals of non-produced, non-financial assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Capital account balance, excluding reserves and related items
structure:Code.common:Description: Capital account balance, excluding reserves and related items.

structure:Code.common:Name: Marginal Comparative Advantage
structure:Code.common:Description: A country never had comparative advantage in exporting the given service in the period 2000-13.

structure:Code.common:Name: Imports of goods
structure:Code.common:Description: Changes in the economic ownership of goods from nonresidents to residents of the compiling economy, irrespective of physical movement of goods across national borders.

structure:Code.common:Name: Imports of goods and services
structure:Code.common:Description: The import (purchase or barter) of physical, produced objects (goods) and services over which ownership rights can be established and whose ownership can be transferred from one institutional unit to another by engaging in transactions on markets by residents in one territory to residents in another territory. Imports reflect a change in the economic ownership of goods from residents of the compiling economy to non-residents, irrespective of physical movement of goods across national borders. The f.o.b. price (free on board price) of exports and imports of goods is the market value of the goods at the point of uniform valuation, (the customs frontier of the economy from which they are exported). It is equal to the c.i.f. price less the costs of transportation and insurance charges, between the customs frontier of the exporting (importing) country and that of the importing (exporting) country. This indicator appears in other datasets published by the IMF. While every effort is made to ensure that estimates for the same indicator are consistent across different datasets, differences can occur due to differences in compilation methodology, reference year, splicing series to preserve time-series continuity, and when the data were collected, processed, and published.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net lending (+) / net borrowing (-)
structure:Code.common:Description: Net lending is the difference between changes in net worth due to saving and capital transfers and net acquisitions of non-financial assets (acquisitions less disposals of non-financial assets, less depreciation). If the amount is negative, it represents net borrowing. In the external accounts, it represents the sum of the balances on the current and capital accounts. This is conceptually equal to the net balance of the financial account. If the balance is positive, it is called net lending, implying that in net terms, the economy supplies funds to the rest of the world. If the balance is negative, it is called net borrowing, implying that in net terms, the economy receives funds from the rest of the world.

structure:Code.common:Name: Exports of goods
structure:Code.common:Description: The export (sale or barter) of physical, produced objects (goods) over which ownership rights can be established and whose ownership can be transferred from one institutional unit to another by engaging in transactions on markets by residents in one territory to residents in another territory. Exports reflect a change in the economic ownership of goods from residents of the compiling economy to non-residents, irrespective of physical movement of goods across national borders. The f.o.b. price (free on board price) of exports and imports of goods is the market value of the goods at the point of uniform valuation, (the customs frontier of the economy from which they are exported). It is equal to the c.i.f. price less the costs of transportation and insurance charges, between the customs frontier of the exporting (importing) country and that of the importing (exporting) country. This indicator appears in other datasets published by the IMF. While every effort is made to ensure that estimates for the same indicator are consistent across different datasets, differences can occur due to differences in compilation methodology, reference year, splicing series to preserve time-series continuity, and when the data were collected, processed, and published.

structure:Code.common:Name: Exports of goods and services
structure:Code.common:Description: The export (sale or barter) of physical, produced objects (goods) and services over which ownership rights can be established and whose ownership can be transferred from one institutional unit to another by engaging in transactions on markets by residents in one territory to residents in another territory. Exports reflect a change in the economic ownership of goods from residents of the compiling economy to non-residents, irrespective of physical movement of goods across national borders. The f.o.b. price (free on board price) of exports and imports of goods is the market value of the goods at the point of uniform valuation, (the customs frontier of the economy from which they are exported). It is equal to the c.i.f. price less the costs of transportation and insurance charges, between the customs frontier of the exporting (importing) country and that of the importing (exporting) country. This indicator appears in other datasets published by the IMF. While every effort is made to ensure that estimates for the same indicator are consistent across different datasets, differences can occur due to differences in compilation methodology, reference year, splicing series to preserve time-series continuity, and when the data were collected, processed, and published.
