structure:Code.common:Name: International Labor Organization (ILO)
structure:Code.common:Description: Statistical standards and guidelines related to labor issues, developed by the International Labor Organization.

structure:Code.common:Name: International Merchandise Trade Statistics (IMTS)
structure:Code.common:Description: A statistical framework for measuring the flow of goods across international borders.

structure:Code.common:Name: International Merchandise Trade Statistics: Concepts and Definitions 2010 (IMTS 2010)
structure:Code.common:Description: Provides a framework for compiling international merchandise trade statistics, covering concepts, definitions, and classifications.

structure:Code.common:Name: International Recommendations for Tourism Statistics 2008 (IRTS 2008)
structure:Code.common:Description: https://unstats.un.org/unsd/tradekb/Knowledgebase/50551/IRTS-2008

structure:Code.common:Name: International Reserves and Foreign Currency Liquidity: Guidelines for a Data Template 2013 (IRFCL 2013)
structure:Code.common:Description: Offers guidelines for compiling data on international reserves and foreign currency liquidity, focusing on data consistency and transparency.

structure:Code.common:Name: International Standard Classification of Education 2011 (ISCED 2011)
structure:Code.common:Description: http://www.uis.unesco.org/Education/Pages/international-standard-classification-of-education.aspx

structure:Code.common:Name: International Standard Industrial Classification (ISIC)
structure:Code.common:Description: A standard classification system used in statistical analysis to categorize economic activities.

structure:Code.common:Name: International Standard Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities, Rev. 3 (ISIC Rev. 3)
structure:Code.common:Description: https://unstats.un.org/unsd/classifications/Econ/ISIC.cshtml

structure:Code.common:Name: International Standard Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities, Rev. 3.1 (ISIC Rev. 3.1) 2004
structure:Code.common:Description: https://unstats.un.org/unsd/classifications/Econ/ISIC.cshtml

structure:Code.common:Name: International Standard Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities, Rev. 4 (ISIC Rev. 4) 2008
structure:Code.common:Description: https://unstats.un.org/unsd/classifications/Econ/ISIC.cshtml

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary and Financial Statistics (MFS)
structure:Code.common:Description: A statistical framework for collecting and analyzing data on money supply, credit, and financial institutions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary and Financial Statistics Manual and Compilation Guide 2016 (MFS 2016)
structure:Code.common:Description: Provides a framework for compiling monetary and financial statistics, covering financial institutions, instruments, and markets. It aims to promote consistency and cross-country comparability.

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary and Financial Statistics Manual and Compilation Guide 2016 (MFS 2016), Concepts Based on Euro Area Wide Residency
structure:Code.common:Description: A version of MFS16 adapted for the specific circumstances of the Euro Area.

structure:Code.common:Name: National Accounts Statistics (SNA)
structure:Code.common:Description: A statistical framework for macroeconomic accounting, providing a consistent system for measuring economic activity.

structure:Code.common:Name: System of National Accounts 1993 (SNA 1993)
structure:Code.common:Description: A comprehensive international framework for macroeconomic accounting, providing a consistent system for measuring economic activity. It covers production, income, consumption, accumulation, and capital formation.

structure:Code.common:Name: System of National Accounts 2008 (SNA 2008)
structure:Code.common:Description: An update to SNA 1993 that incorporates changes in economic activity and measurement. It provides expanded guidance on financial services, globalization, and environmental-economic accounting.

structure:Code.common:Name: OECD Benchmark Definition of Foreign Direct Investment (BMD4)
structure:Code.common:Description: The OECD's definition of foreign direct investment, providing guidance on measuring and classifying FDI.

structure:Code.common:Name: Per National Definition
structure:Code.common:Description: Indicates that the definition or methodology is determined by each country's own standards.

structure:Code.common:Name: Population Statistics
structure:Code.common:Description: Statistical methods for collecting and analyzing data on the size, distribution, and characteristics of populations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Quality Assurance (QA)
structure:Code.common:Description: Statistical standards and procedures used to ensure the quality of data and statistics.

structure:Code.common:Name: Standard International Trade Classification, Rev. 2 (SITC Rev. 2) 1975
structure:Code.common:Description: https://unstats.un.org/unsd/classifications/Family/Detail/1070

structure:Code.common:Name: Standard International Trade Classification, Rev. 4 (SITC Rev. 4) 2007
structure:Code.common:Description: https://unstats.un.org/unsd/publications/catalogue?selectID=104

structure:Code.common:Name: Statistical Classification of Economic Activities in the European Community, Rev. 2 (NACE Rev. 2) 2008
structure:Code.common:Description: https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/documents/3859598/5902521/KS-RA-07-015-EN.PDF https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/ramon/nomenclatures/index.cfm?TargetUrl=LST_NOM_DTL&StrNom=NACE_REV2&StrLanguageCode=EN

structure:Code.common:Name: Statistical classification of products by activity 2008 (CPA 2008)
structure:Code.common:Description: https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/ramon/nomenclatures/index.cfm?TargetUrl=LST_NOM_DTL&StrNom=CPA_2008&StrLanguageCode=EN&IntPcKey=&StrLayoutCode=HIERARCHIC

structure:Code.common:Name: Producer Price Index Manual: Theory and Practice
structure:Code.common:Description: https://www.imf.org/en/Publications/Manuals-Guides/Issues/2016/12/30/Producer-Price-Index-Manual-Theory-and-Practice-16966

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary and Financial Statistics Manual and Compilation Guide 2000 (MFS 2000)
structure:Code.common:Description: An earlier version of the MGS manual, providing similar guidance for compiling monetary and financial statistics.

structure:Code.common:Name: International Recommendations for the Index of Industrial Production 2010
structure:Code.common:Description: A global guideline for countries to uniformly measure and report industrial output changes (Index of Industrial Production - IIP), ensuring international data comparability.

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary and Financial Statistics non-standard reporting
structure:Code.common:Description: The Monetary and Financial Statistics (MFS) nonstandard dataset is compiled using country-specific methodologies and terminology, rather than the standard methodology outlined in different versions of Monetary and Financial Statistics Manual.

structure:Code.common:Name: Export and Import Price Index Manual: Theory and Practice 2009
structure:Code.common:Description: This manual provides guidance on how to construct a price index for exports and imports. It is relevant to statistical agencies involved in the compilation of export and import price indexes. This 2009 edition updates the 1999 edition and incorporates recent methodological advances. https://www.imf.org/-/media/files/data/manuals-guides/eipim_2009_book.ashx

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary and Financial Statistics Compilation Guide 2008
structure:Code.common:Description: This guide provides a framework for compiling monetary and financial statistics, offering practical advice and examples to statistical compilers. It is designed to assist countries in producing high-quality monetary and financial statistics that are comparable internationally. https://www.imf.org/-/media/Files/Data/manuals-guides/mfs-guide-2008.ashx

structure:Code.common:Name: A Guide to Money and Banking Statistics in IFS 1984
structure:Code.common:Description: This guide explains the methodology and concepts used in compiling money and banking statistics for the International Financial Statistics (IFS). It is relevant to users and compilers of these statistics, providing context for the data presented in the IFS.

structure:Code.common:Name: International Merchandise Trade Statistics 1998 (IMTS 1998)
structure:Code.common:Description: This manual provides a framework of concepts and definitions for the compilation of international merchandise trade statistics. It is relevant to national statistical authorities involved in collecting, compiling, and disseminating trade data, promoting international comparability.

structure:Code.common:Name: Balance of Payments Manual, fourth edition (BPM4)
structure:Code.common:Description: This manual sets forth the conceptual framework for the compilation of balance of payments statistics. It provides guidelines for statistical agencies to ensure consistency and comparability of balance of payments data across countries.

structure:Code.common:Name: External Debt Statistics Guide 2013 (EDS 2013)
structure:Code.common:Description: This guide provides comprehensive methodological guidance for the compilation, dissemination, and use of external debt statistics. It is relevant to compilers in national statistical agencies, central banks, and ministries of finance, as well as to users of external debt data. https://www.imf.org/-/media/Files/Data/manuals-guides/eds_guide2013.ashx

structure:Code.common:Name: External Debt Statistics Guide 2003 (EDS 2003)
structure:Code.common:Description: This guide provides methodological guidance for the compilation, dissemination, and use of external debt statistics. It was a predecessor to the 2013 edition, offering a framework for data collection and presentation relevant to the period. https://www.imf.org/-/media/Files/Data/manuals-guides/eds_guide2003.ashx

structure:Code.common:Name: Consumer Price Index Manual 2004 (CPI 2004)
structure:Code.common:Description: This manual provides guidelines for statistical offices and other agencies responsible for constructing Consumer Price Indexes (CPIs), explaining methods, underlying economic and statistical concepts, and principles. https://www.elibrary.imf.org/display/book/9789221136996/9789221136996.xml

structure:Code.common:Name: Producer Price Index Manual 2004 (PPI 2004)
structure:Code.common:Description: This manual provides clear, up-to-date guidance on the concepts, uses, methods, and economic theory of the Producer Price Index (PPI), including information on classifications, sources, compilation techniques, and analytical uses. It supersedes previous international guidance on PPIs. https://www.elibrary.imf.org/display/book/9781589063044/9781589063044.xml

structure:Code.common:Name: Consumer Price Index Manual 2020 (CPI 2020)
structure:Code.common:Description: This manual, an update of the 2004 CPI Manual, provides comprehensive information and explanations on compiling a consumer price index (CPI). Its primary purpose is to assist countries in producing CPIs that reflect internationally recommended methods and practices. https://www.elibrary.imf.org/display/book/9781484354841/9781484354841.xml

structure:Code.common:Name: System of Environmental-Economic Accounting (SEEA)
structure:Code.common:Description: https://seea.un.org/

structure:Code.common:Name: System of National Accounts 2025 (SNA 2025)
structure:Code.common:Description: The latest update to the SNA framework, reflecting new developments in the global economy, digitalization, sustainability, and well-being. It enhances guidance on globalization, financial innovation, environmental and social dimensions, and emerging data sources.

structure:Code.common:Name: Integrated Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual, Seventh Edition (BPM7)
structure:Code.common:Description: Released in 2025, BPM7 updates the global framework for external sector statistics, incorporating developments in digitalization, globalization, and financial markets while strengthening integration with the 2025 SNA.

structure:Codelist.common:Name: Institutional Sector
structure:Codelist.common:Description: This codelist represents a classification of institutional units based on their economic function and role in the economy, such as households, non-financial corporations, financial corporations, or government.

structure:Code.common:Name: Affiliated entities
structure:Code.common:Description: Enterprises linked through a direct or indirect ownership or control relationships.

structure:Code.common:Name: All resident sectors excluding financial intermediaries (CDIS)
structure:Code.common:Description: All resident sectors excluding financial intermediaries as per Coordinated Direct Investment Survey guidelines.

structure:Code.common:Name: All sectors other than households and NPISH
structure:Code.common:Description: All institutional sectors except households and non-profit institutions serving households.

structure:Code.common:Name: Deposit-taking corporations, except the central bank
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial corporations, excluding the central bank, that are principally engaged in financial intermediation and incur liabilities in the form of deposits and/or close substitutes for deposits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Banks and other financial institutions headquartered in the reporting country or currency area
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial institutions headquartered in the reporting country or currency area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Banks and other financial institutions headquartered outside the reporting country or currency area
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial institutions headquartered outside the reporting country or currency area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Banks headquartered in the reporting country or currency area
structure:Code.common:Description: Banks headquartered in the reporting country or currency area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Banks headquartered outside the reporting country or currency area
structure:Code.common:Description: Banks headquartered outside the reporting country or currency area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Bond funds
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment funds primarily investing in bonds.

structure:Code.common:Name: Budgetary central government
structure:Code.common:Description: Central government operations financed through the general budget.

structure:Code.common:Name: Budgetary units, central government
structure:Code.common:Description: Units within the central government financed by budgetary resources.

structure:Code.common:Name: Captive financial institutions and money lenders
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial entities providing services within a group, often for tax or legal purposes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Captive financial institutions and money lenders (sub-sector not identified)
structure:Code.common:Description: Captive financial institutions and money lenders where the specific sub-sector is not identified.

structure:Code.common:Name: Central and state government excluding social security
structure:Code.common:Description: Combined central and state government operations excluding social security funds.

structure:Code.common:Name: Central bank
structure:Code.common:Description: The monetary authority of a country responsible for issuing currency and regulating the banking system.

structure:Code.common:Name: Central banks and general government
structure:Code.common:Description: Includes central banks and all general government sectors.

structure:Code.common:Name: Central clearing counterparties, which are part of other OFIs
structure:Code.common:Description: Entities part of other financial intermediaries providing clearing and settlement services.

structure:Code.common:Name: Central government
structure:Code.common:Description: Central government including both budgetary and non-budgetary units.

structure:Code.common:Name: Central government excluding social security
structure:Code.common:Description: Central government operations excluding social security funds.

structure:Code.common:Name: Central government including social security
structure:Code.common:Description: Central government operations including social security funds.

structure:Code.common:Name: Central government non profit institutions
structure:Code.common:Description: Non-profit institutions operated by or closely linked to the central government.

structure:Code.common:Name: Closed-end bond funds
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment funds issuing fixed shares and primarily investing in bonds.

structure:Code.common:Name: Closed-end equity funds
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment funds issuing fixed shares and primarily investing in equities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Closed-end hedge funds
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment funds issuing fixed shares and employing hedge fund strategies.

structure:Code.common:Name: Closed-end mixed funds
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment funds issuing fixed shares and investing in a mix of asset classes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Closed-end non MMFs
structure:Code.common:Description: Closed-end funds that are not money market funds.

structure:Code.common:Name: Closed-end real estate funds
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment funds issuing fixed shares and primarily investing in real estate.

structure:Code.common:Name: Deposit-taking corporations, except the central bank
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial corporations, excluding the central bank, that are principally engaged in financial intermediation and incur liabilities in the form of deposits and/or close substitutes for deposits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Composite life and non-life insurance corporations excluding reinsurance corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Insurance corporations providing both life and non-life insurance products.

structure:Code.common:Name: Constant net asset value (NAV) MMFs
structure:Code.common:Description: Money market funds maintaining a constant net asset value per share.

structure:Code.common:Name: Corporate groups captive financial entities
structure:Code.common:Description: Captive financial entities serving corporate groups.

structure:Code.common:Name: Corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: All corporations operating within the economy - including non-financial and financial corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Money Lenders
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial institutions primarily engaged in providing credit.

structure:Code.common:Name: Credit unions and credit cooperatives
structure:Code.common:Description: Are financial institutions owned and controlled by their members, regardless of whether they do business exclusively with their members, and/or non-members. Credit unions accept deposits (technically these may be designated as shares) and make various types of loans

structure:Code.common:Name: Defined benefit funds
structure:Code.common:Description: Pension funds that promise a specified benefit to participants based on salary and years of service.

structure:Code.common:Name: Defined contribution funds
structure:Code.common:Description: Pension funds where contributions are defined, and benefits depend on investment returns.

structure:Code.common:Name: Deposit takers
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial corporations primarily accepting deposits and lending.

structure:Code.common:Name: Deposit taking corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial corporations that accept deposits, excluding central banks.

structure:Code.common:Name: Deposit taking corporations, except the Central Bank
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial corporations accepting deposits, except for the central bank.

structure:Code.common:Name: Deposit taking corporations, except the Central Bank (sub-sector not identified)
structure:Code.common:Description: Deposit-taking corporations with an unidentified sub-sector.

structure:Code.common:Name: Deposit taking microfinance institutions
structure:Code.common:Description: Deposit taking microfinance institutions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Depository corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial corporations engaged in accepting deposits and lending or investing funds.

structure:Code.common:Name: Deposit-taking corporations and other sectors
structure:Code.common:Description: Includes deposit-taking corporations and other institutional sectors.

structure:Code.common:Name: Deposit-taking corporations except the central bank and excluding electronic money institutions principally engaged in financial intermediation
structure:Code.common:Description: Excludes institutions primarily engaged in financial intermediation with e-money.

structure:Code.common:Name: Domestic debtor
structure:Code.common:Description: Refers to entities within the country owing debts.

structure:Code.common:Name: Domestically controlled financial corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial corporations controlled by residents of the reporting country.

structure:Code.common:Name: Domestically controlled non-financial corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Non-financial corporations controlled by residents of the reporting country.

structure:Code.common:Name: Electronic money institutions
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial institutions issuing electronic money.

structure:Code.common:Name: Electronic money non-financial corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Non-financial corporations issuing electronic money.

structure:Code.common:Name: Employees
structure:Code.common:Description: Individuals engaged in paid employment.

structure:Code.common:Name: Employers
structure:Code.common:Description: Institutional units that employ workers and provide remuneration.

structure:Code.common:Name: Equity funds
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment funds primarily investing in equities.

structure:Code.common:Name: European institutions and bodies (EU accounts)
structure:Code.common:Description: European Union institutions involved in managing EU accounts.

structure:Code.common:Name: External creditors
structure:Code.common:Description: Non-resident institutional units that are creditors to resident units. Counterparty concept; not an institutional sector.

structure:Code.common:Name: Extrabudgetary central government
structure:Code.common:Description: Units of central government funded outside the main budget.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial auxiliaries
structure:Code.common:Description: Entities providing support services to financial corporations; and do not take control of the assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial auxiliaries (sub-sector not identified)
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial auxiliaries with unidentified sub-sector.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Corporations engaged in market financial services including financial intermediation or auxiliary services.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial corporations engaged in lending
structure:Code.common:Description: Corporations primarily focused on providing loans or credit.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial corporations other than central banks
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial corporations excluding central banks.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial corporations other than central banks and credit institutions
structure:Code.common:Description: Corporations other than central banks and credit institutions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial corporations other than MFIs
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial corporations excluding monetary financial institutions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial corporations other than the central bank
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial corporations excluding the central bank.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial corporations, nonfinancial corporations, households, and NPISHs
structure:Code.common:Description: All institutional sectors except the rest of the world.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial corporations, SPEs
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial corporations including special purpose entities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial intermediaries (CDIS)
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial intermediaries as per Coordinated Direct Investment Survey guidelines.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial vehicle corporations engaged in securitisation
structure:Code.common:Description: Entities involved in securitisation by issuing securities backed by pooled assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign controlled
structure:Code.common:Description: Entities controlled by non-residents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign controlled captive financial institutions and money lenders
structure:Code.common:Description: Captive financial institutions controlled by non-residents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign controlled deposit taking corporations, except the Central Bank
structure:Code.common:Description: Deposit-taking corporations controlled by non-residents, excluding central banks.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign controlled financial auxiliaries
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial auxiliaries controlled by non-residents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign controlled financial corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial corporations controlled by non-residents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign controlled insurance corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Insurance corporations controlled by non-residents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign controlled money market funds
structure:Code.common:Description: Money market funds controlled by non-residents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign controlled non MMF investment funds
structure:Code.common:Description: Non-MMF investment funds controlled by non-residents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign controlled non-financial corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Non-financial corporations controlled by non-residents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign controlled other financial intermediaries, except insurance corporations and pension funds
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial intermediaries other than insurance and pension funds, controlled by non-residents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign controlled pension funds
structure:Code.common:Description: Pension funds controlled by non-residents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign owned SPE-type captives
structure:Code.common:Description: Captive financial institutions operating as special purpose entities, foreign-owned.

structure:Code.common:Name: General government
structure:Code.common:Description: The general government sector consists of such institutional units at central, state and local level together with social security funds and non-market producers controlled by them.

structure:Code.common:Name: General government and institutions financed by the European Union (EU) budget (including the European Development Fund (EDF))
structure:Code.common:Description: General government institutions financed by the EU budget, including the European Development Fund.

structure:Code.common:Name: General government and institutions of the European Union (ESA GFS concept)
structure:Code.common:Description: General government and EU institutions defined by ESA GFS concepts.

structure:Code.common:Name: General government excluding social security
structure:Code.common:Description: Central, state, and local governments, excluding social security funds.

structure:Code.common:Name: General government involved in monetary policy operations
structure:Code.common:Description: General government units involved in monetary policy operations.

structure:Code.common:Name: General government non profit institutions
structure:Code.common:Description: Non-profit institutions controlled and mainly financed by general government.

structure:Code.common:Name: General government, except central government
structure:Code.common:Description: Includes state and local governments, excluding central government.

structure:Code.common:Name: General government, except local government
structure:Code.common:Description: Includes central and state governments, excluding local government.

structure:Code.common:Name: General government, except social security funds
structure:Code.common:Description: General government excluding social security funds.

structure:Code.common:Name: General government, except state government
structure:Code.common:Description: Includes central and local governments, excluding state government.

structure:Code.common:Name: General government, households and non profit institutions serving households
structure:Code.common:Description: Includes general government, households, and non-profit institutions serving households.

structure:Code.common:Name: Government, various levels
structure:Code.common:Description: Refers to a combination or mix of different levels of government within a country or region, such as national (central), regional (state/province), and local (municipal/county) governments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Head offices of financial corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Head office units overseeing the operations of financial corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Head offices of non-financial corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Head office units overseeing the operations of non-financial corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Hedge funds
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment funds engaging in diverse and complex strategies to maximize returns.

structure:Code.common:Name: Holding companies
structure:Code.common:Description: Companies whose primary purpose is to hold shares in other corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Households
structure:Code.common:Description: Institutional units consisting of individuals or groups of persons who share living accommodation, pool income and wealth, and consume collectively

structure:Code.common:Name: Households and non profit institutions serving households (NPISH)
structure:Code.common:Description: Includes households and non-profit institutions serving households.

structure:Code.common:Name: Institutions financed by the European Union (EU) budget (including the European Development Fund (EDF))
structure:Code.common:Description: Entities funded by the European Union budget, including the European Development Fund.

structure:Code.common:Name: Institutions of the European Union (ESA GFS concept)
structure:Code.common:Description: Institutions of the EU defined by ESA GFS concepts.

structure:Code.common:Name: Insurance corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Are financial institutions whose principal function is to provide life, accident, sickness, fire, or other forms of coverage to individual institutional units, groups of units, or reinsurance services to other insurance corporations. For the purposes of the FAS, insurance corporations are disaggregated into life and non-life.

structure:Code.common:Name: Insurance corporations (sub-sector not identified)
structure:Code.common:Description: Insurance corporations with unidentified sub-sector.

structure:Code.common:Name: Insurance corporations and Pension Funds
structure:Code.common:Description: Includes insurance corporations and pension funds.

structure:Code.common:Name: International organizations
structure:Code.common:Description: Organizations established by treaties between sovereign states or other international agreements.

structure:Code.common:Name: Investment funds (MMFs and non-MMFs)
structure:Code.common:Description: Includes both money market funds and non-money market funds.

structure:Code.common:Name: Issuer headquartered in the reporting country or currency area
structure:Code.common:Description: Entities issuing financial instruments, headquartered in the reporting country or currency area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Life insurance corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Insurance corporations offering life insurance policies.

structure:Code.common:Name: Life insurance corporations excluding reinsurance corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Life insurance corporations, excluding reinsurance entities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Local government excluding social security
structure:Code.common:Description: Local government units excluding social security schemes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Local government including social security
structure:Code.common:Description: Local government units, including social security schemes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Local government non-profit institutions
structure:Code.common:Description: Non-profit institutions controlled and mainly financed by local governments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Local government, budgetary units
structure:Code.common:Description: Budgetary units within local government.

structure:Code.common:Name: Local government, extra-budgetary units
structure:Code.common:Description: Extra-budgetary units within local government.

structure:Code.common:Name: All Microfinance institutions
structure:Code.common:Description: All Microfinance institutions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Mixed funds
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment funds combining various asset types such as bonds, equities, and other securities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Mobile money service provider
structure:Code.common:Description: Refers to a mobile network operator or other entity that partners with mobile network operators to offer mobile money services to its clients through agents independent of the traditional banking network

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary authorities
structure:Code.common:Description: Institutions responsible for controlling a country's monetary policy, primarily central banks.

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary authorities and international organizations
structure:Code.common:Description: Includes central banks and international organizations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary financial institutions (MFI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial corporations engaged in monetary intermediation, including central banks and deposit-taking corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary financial institutions (sub-sector not identified)
structure:Code.common:Description: MFIs with unidentified sub-sector classification.

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary financial institutions other than central bank
structure:Code.common:Description: Monetary financial institutions excluding central banks.

structure:Code.common:Name: Money market funds
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment funds that invest in short-term debt instruments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Money market funds (sub-sector not identified)
structure:Code.common:Description: Money market funds with unidentified sub-sector classification.

structure:Code.common:Name: National private
structure:Code.common:Description: Refers to entities owned or controlled by private domestic interests.

structure:Code.common:Name: National private captive financial institutions and money lenders
structure:Code.common:Description: Captive financial institutions owned by private domestic interests.

structure:Code.common:Name: National private deposit taking corporations, except the Central Bank
structure:Code.common:Description: Deposit-taking corporations owned by private domestic interests.

structure:Code.common:Name: National private financial and non-financial corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Corporations owned by private domestic interests, spanning both financial and non-financial sectors.

structure:Code.common:Name: National private financial auxiliaries
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial auxiliaries owned by private domestic interests.

structure:Code.common:Name: National private financial corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial corporations owned by private domestic interests.

structure:Code.common:Name: National private financial corporations which are part of domestic multinationals
structure:Code.common:Description: Domestic financial corporations integrated into multinational groups.
