structure:Codelist.common:Name: Instrument and assets classification
structure:Codelist.common:Description: Because of the symmetry of financial assets and liabilities, the term ‘instrument’ is used to relate to both the asset and the liability aspect of financial transactions, other flows and financial balance sheets. (Source: Handbook of National Accounting, 2013)

structure:Code.common:Name: Not applicable
structure:Code.common:Description: Not relevant or not suitable to the context.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net financial worth
structure:Code.common:Description: The difference between total financial assets and total financial liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net financial worth: excluding pension liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: The difference between total financial assets and total financial liabilities, excluding pension liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Economic resources owned by an entity that can provide future benefits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Acquisition of foreign assets
structure:Code.common:Description: The purchase or acquisition of financial or non-financial assets located in foreign countries.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total assets (gross)
structure:Code.common:Description: The total value of all economic resources owned by an entity, before deducting any liabilities or depreciation. This includes both financial and non-financial assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Assets: short position
structure:Code.common:Description: A position in financial markets where the value of assets sold exceeds the value of assets owned.

structure:Code.common:Name: Assets excluding land and natural resources
structure:Code.common:Description: Economic resources owned by an entity, excluding land and natural resources.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities or debt to banks
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial obligations owed to banking institutions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Stock of reserves
structure:Code.common:Description: The total amount of reserve assets held by a central bank or monetary authority. These assets typically include monetary gold, Special Drawing Rights (SDRs), foreign currency holdings, and reserve positions in the IMF.

structure:Code.common:Name: Use of IMF Credit and Loans
structure:Code.common:Description: Use of IMF Credit and Loans comprises of a member country's purchases as well as borrowings under the various lMF's lending instruments to meet the different needs and specific circumstances of its members. IMF members have access to the General Resources Account (GRA) on non-concessional terms (market-based interest rates), but the IMF also provides concessional financial support (currently at zero interest rates) through the Poverty Reduction and Growth Trust (PRGT) and the recently established Resilience and Sustainability Trust (RST).

structure:Code.common:Name: Claims on
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial claims or entitlements held by an entity.

structure:Code.common:Name: Contingent Liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: Potential obligations that may arise based on the outcome of future events.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt claims on nonresidents
structure:Code.common:Description: Claims for debt owed by nonresidents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt claims on nonresidents, inter-company lending
structure:Code.common:Description: Claims for debt owed by nonresidents arising from inter-company lending.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total debt claims on nonresidents
structure:Code.common:Description: The total amount of debt claims held against nonresidents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt
structure:Code.common:Description: Money borrowed by one party from another, typically evidenced by a note which specifies, among other things, the principal amount, interest rate, and date of repayment.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt liabilities to nonresidents
structure:Code.common:Description: Liabilities owed to nonresidents in the form of debt.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt liabilities to nonresidents: inter-company lending
structure:Code.common:Description: Liabilities owed to nonresidents arising from inter-company lending.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt (at market value)
structure:Code.common:Description: The value of debt calculated based on the current market price of the debt instruments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total financial assets/liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: The total value of financial assets and liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary gold and SDRs
structure:Code.common:Description: Gold held as a reserve asset and Special Drawing Rights (SDRs) allocated by the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary gold
structure:Code.common:Description: Gold held as a reserve asset.

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary gold: unallocated gold accounts
structure:Code.common:Description: Gold accounts where the holder owns a share of a pool of gold rather than specific gold bars.

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary gold: of which gold under swap for cash collateral
structure:Code.common:Description: Portion of monetary gold that is held under swap agreements for cash collateral.

structure:Code.common:Name: Special Drawing Rights (SDRs)
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve assets created by the International Monetary Fund and allocated to its members to supplement existing reserve assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Special Drawing Rights (SDRs): allocations: accumulation of arrears
structure:Code.common:Description: Accumulated arrears related to allocations of Special Drawing Rights by the IMF.

structure:Code.common:Name: Special Drawing Rights (SDRs): allocations
structure:Code.common:Description: SDR allocations are reserve assets created by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and allocated to its member countries to supplement existing reserve assets. Special Drawing Rights (SDRs) are international reserve assets that the IMF allocates to its members as a form of supplementary liquidity. These allocations are based on each member country's IMF quota and are intended to provide additional liquidity and support to the global financial system.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gold (including gold deposits and, if appropriate, gold swapped)
structure:Code.common:Description: The total amount of gold held by an entity, including physical gold, gold deposits held with other institutions, and any gold held under swap agreements. This includes gold held as a reserve asset and other forms of gold holdings.

structure:Code.common:Name: SDRs holdings
structure:Code.common:Description: SDR Holdings refer to an interest-bearing reserve asset created by the IMF to supplement members’ reserve assets. It is a purely official asset and can only be held and used by members in the SDR department, the IMF, and certain designated official entities. SDR holdings can be exchanged with other members for freely usable currency.

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary gold
structure:Code.common:Description: Gold held as a reserve asset.

structure:Code.common:Name: Currency and deposits
structure:Code.common:Description: Monetary assets held in the form of currency or in deposit accounts with financial institutions.

structure:Code.common:Name: IMF holdings of currency
structure:Code.common:Description: IMF’s Holdings of Currencies represent members’ paid-in quota subscription in local currencies that are held in designated depository agencies (e.g., central banks). Currency holdings are held in three accounts: IMF No. 1, IMF No. 2, and IMF Securities Accounts.

structure:Code.common:Name: Inter-bank positions
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial positions held by banks with other banks.

structure:Code.common:Name: Currency and deposits: fixed rate
structure:Code.common:Description: Currency and deposits that earn interest at a fixed rate.

structure:Code.common:Name: Deposits
structure:Code.common:Description: Non-negotiable contracts that represent the placements of funds available for later withdrawal. They are claims on the central bank, other deposit-taking corporations, other financial corporations, and, in some cases, other institutional units.

structure:Code.common:Name: Currency and deposits: variable rate
structure:Code.common:Description: Currency and deposits that earn interest at a variable rate.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt securities
structure:Code.common:Description: Tradable financial instruments representing a debt, such as bonds and notes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt securities: bonds and notes
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt securities that are long-term obligations issued by a borrower to raise capital, typically with a fixed interest rate, such as bonds and notes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt securities: financial derivatives
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial instruments whose value is derived from the performance of underlying debt securities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt securities: accumulation of arrears
structure:Code.common:Description: The buildup of unpaid interest or principal on debt securities that has become overdue.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt securities: accumulation of arrears, interest / coupon
structure:Code.common:Description: The buildup of unpaid interest or coupon payments on debt securities that has become overdue.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt securities: accumulation of arrears, original interest / coupon
structure:Code.common:Description: The buildup of unpaid original interest or coupon payments on debt securities that has become overdue.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt securities: accumulation of arrears, principal
structure:Code.common:Description: The buildup of unpaid principal on debt securities that has become overdue.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt securities: accumulation of arrears, penalty interest
structure:Code.common:Description: The buildup of unpaid penalty interest on debt securities that has become overdue.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt securities: fixed rate
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt securities that pay a fixed rate of interest.

structure:Code.common:Name: High quality tradable securities
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial instruments that are highly rated and can be easily traded in financial markets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Issues of new debt securities
structure:Code.common:Description: The process of offering new debt instruments for sale to investors.

structure:Code.common:Name: Issues of new debt securities on behalf of authorities
structure:Code.common:Description: Issuing new debt instruments on behalf of governmental or regulatory authorities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt securities: (unofficial)
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt securities that are not issued by official entities or private entities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt securities: (official)
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt securities issued by official entities, such as governments or central banks.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt securities: (private)
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt securities issued by private entities, such as corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt securities: short or negative positions
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt securities positions where the holder has sold securities they do not own, betting on a decline in the price, or positions that result in a liability greater than the value of the securities held.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt securities and loans
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial instruments representing a debt obligation, such as bonds and notes, and loans which involve borrowing a sum of money that is expected to be paid back typically with interest.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt securities: variable rate
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt securities that pay interest at a variable rate, which can change over time based on a benchmark rate or index.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt securities: excluding exceptional financing
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt securities that exclude those related to exceptional financing arrangements.

structure:Code.common:Name: Loans
structure:Code.common:Description: Sums of money that are borrowed and expected to be paid back typically with interest.

structure:Code.common:Name: Credit lines
structure:Code.common:Description: Pre-approved lines of credit that can be drawn upon as needed by the borrower, and in some cases when conditions are met.

structure:Code.common:Name: Loans, credit, and loans with the IMF (other than reserves)
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial instruments including loans, credit, and loans with the International Monetary Fund (IMF), excluding those held as reserves.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net credit and loans from the IMF (excluding reserve position)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net amount of credit and loans received from the International Monetary Fund (IMF), excluding those held in reserve positions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Concessional loans
structure:Code.common:Description: Loans provided on terms more generous than market conditions, often with lower (or zero) interest rates or longer repayment periods.

structure:Code.common:Name: Implicit transfers resulting from loans at concessional interest rates
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial benefits given to borrowers through loans offered at below-market interest rates.

structure:Code.common:Name: Loans: fixed rate
structure:Code.common:Description: Loans that have a fixed interest rate for the entire term of the loan.

structure:Code.common:Name: Lending to the IMF (GRA)
structure:Code.common:Description: Lending to the IMF involves IMF member countries providing financial support to the IMF to enable the IMF to fulfill its mandate of providing loans and assistance to member countries facing balance of payments problems or other economic challenges.

structure:Code.common:Name: Nonperforming loan assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Loans that are in default or close to being in default because the borrower has not made scheduled payments for a specified period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Loans: variable rate
structure:Code.common:Description: Loans that have an interest rate that can fluctuate over the term of the loan.

structure:Code.common:Name: Equity and investment fund shares
structure:Code.common:Description: Residual claims on the assets of the institutional units that issued the relevant instruments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Equity
structure:Code.common:Description: All instruments and records acknowledging ownership rights and claims on the residual value of a corporation or quasi-corporation after the claims of all creditors have been met. Ownership of equity is usually evidenced by shares, stocks, participations, depository receipts or similar documents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other equity
structure:Code.common:Description: Equity holdings that do not fall under the main categories of shares or stocks.

structure:Code.common:Name: Shares and other equity
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial instruments representing ownership in a corporation, including shares and other forms of equity.

structure:Code.common:Name: Equity securities: excluding exceptional financing
structure:Code.common:Description: Equity securities that exclude those related to exceptional financing arrangements.

structure:Code.common:Name: Investment fund shares/units
structure:Code.common:Description: Shares or units in a fund that pools investor money to purchase securities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Money market fund shares/units
structure:Code.common:Description: Shares or units in funds that invest in short-term, high-liquidity financial instruments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Reinvestment of earnings: of which money market fund shares or units
structure:Code.common:Description: Reinvested earnings specifically in money market fund shares or units.

structure:Code.common:Name: Money market fund shares/units: debt securities
structure:Code.common:Description: Shares or units in money market funds that primarily invest in debt securities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Reinvestment of earnings: of which special purpose entities
structure:Code.common:Description: The portion of reinvested earnings from investment fund shares or units that is specifically attributed to special purpose entities. Special purpose entities are legal entities created to fulfill specific, narrow, or temporary objectives.

structure:Code.common:Name: Investment fund shares/units: reinvestment of earnings
structure:Code.common:Description: Shares or units in investment funds acquired through the reinvestment of earnings.

structure:Code.common:Name: Equity and investment fund shares/units: other than reinvestment of earnings
structure:Code.common:Description: Equity and investment fund shares/units excluding those acquired through the reinvestment of earnings.

structure:Code.common:Name: Equity and investment fund shares/units: reinvestment of earnings
structure:Code.common:Description: Equity and investment fund shares/units acquired through the reinvestment of earnings.

structure:Code.common:Name: Equity and investment fund shares/units (unofficial)
structure:Code.common:Description: Equity and investment fund shares/units of private sector

structure:Code.common:Name: Equity and investment fund shares/units (official)
structure:Code.common:Description: Equity and investment fund shares/units of public sector

structure:Code.common:Name: Equity: short or negative positions
structure:Code.common:Description: Positions where the holder has sold equity they do not own, betting on a decline in the price, or positions that result in a liability greater than the value of the equity held.

structure:Code.common:Name: Equity and investment fund shares/units: excluding exceptional financing
structure:Code.common:Description: Equity and investment fund shares/units that exclude those related to exceptional financing arrangements.

structure:Code.common:Name: Equity and investment fund shares equity: securities other than investment fund shares
structure:Code.common:Description: Equity securities that do not include investment fund shares.

structure:Code.common:Name: Equity and investment fund shares equity: securities other than investment fund shares, listed
structure:Code.common:Description: Listed equity securities that do not include investment fund shares.

structure:Code.common:Name: Equity and investment fund shares equity: securities other than investment fund shares, unlisted
structure:Code.common:Description: Unlisted equity securities that do not include investment fund shares.

structure:Code.common:Name: Insurance, pension and standardized guarantee schemes
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial asset category, grouping together nonlife insurance technical reserves; life insurance and annuity entitlements; pension entitlements; claims of pension funds on pension sponsor; entitlements to nonpension benefits, and provisions for calls under standardized guarantees.

structure:Code.common:Name: Nonlife insurance technical reserves
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserves held by insurance companies to cover claims related to nonlife insurance policies.

structure:Code.common:Name: Life insurance and annuities entitlements
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial claims of policyholders against an institutional unit offering life insurance or providing annuities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Pension entitlements
structure:Code.common:Description: The obligations of pension plans to provide benefits to their members.

structure:Code.common:Name: Claims of pension funds on pension managers
structure:Code.common:Description: The financial claims held by pension funds on pension managers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Entitlements to nonpension benefits
structure:Code.common:Description: Rights to receive benefits other than pensions, such as healthcare or unemployment benefits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Provisions for calls under standardized guarantee schemes
structure:Code.common:Description: Funds set aside to cover potential calls under standardized guarantee schemes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Insurance, pension and standardized guarantee schemes: fixed rate
structure:Code.common:Description: Insurance, pension, and standardized guarantee schemes that offer fixed interest rates.

structure:Code.common:Name: Life insurance and annuity entitlements, pension entitlements, claims of pension funds on pension managers and entitlements to non-pension benefits
structure:Code.common:Description: Combined financial obligations including life insurance and annuity entitlements, pension entitlements, and claims of pension funds on pension managers and entitlements to non-pension benefits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Claims of pension funds on pension managers and entitlements to non-pension benefits
structure:Code.common:Description: The financial claims held by pension funds against pension managers, including entitlements to non-pension benefits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Insurance technical reserves
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserves that insurance companies set aside to cover future claims and policyholder benefits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Insurance, pension and standardized guarantee schemes: variable rate
structure:Code.common:Description: Insurance, pension, and standardized guarantee schemes that offer variable interest rates.

structure:Code.common:Name: Insurance, pension and standardized guarantee schemes
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial arrangements that include insurance policies, pension plans, and standardized guarantees.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial derivatives (other than reserves) and employee stock options
structure:Code.common:Description: Negotiable financial instruments linked to another specific financial instrument, indicator, or commodity, through which specific risks (e.g., interest rate risk, foreign exchange risk, equity and commodity price risk, credit risk) can be traded in their own right in financial markets. Financial derivatives excluding those held as reserves and including employee stock options.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial derivatives
structure:Code.common:Description: Negotiable financial instruments linked to another specific financial instrument, indicator, or commodity, through which specific risks (e.g., interest rate risk, foreign exchange risk, equity and commodity price risk, credit risk) can be traded in their own right in financial markets. Financial instruments whose value is derived from the performance of underlying assets, indexes, or interest rates.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial derivatives (other than reserves) options
structure:Code.common:Description: Negotiable financial instruments linked to another specific financial instrument, indicator, or commodity, through which specific risks (e.g., interest rate risk, foreign exchange risk, equity and commodity price risk, credit risk) can be traded in their own right in financial markets. Options contracts that are financial derivatives excluding those held as reserves.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial derivatives (other than reserves) forward type contracts
structure:Code.common:Description: Negotiable financial instruments linked to another specific financial instrument, indicator, or commodity, through which specific risks (e.g., interest rate risk, foreign exchange risk, equity and commodity price risk, credit risk) can be traded in their own right in financial markets. Forward type contracts that are financial derivatives excluding those held as reserves.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial derivatives (other than reserves)
structure:Code.common:Description: Negotiable financial instruments linked to another specific financial instrument, indicator, or commodity, through which specific risks (e.g., interest rate risk, foreign exchange risk, equity and commodity price risk, credit risk) can be traded in their own right in financial markets. Financial derivatives excluding those held as reserves.

structure:Code.common:Name: Employee stock options
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial instruments granted to employees as part of their compensation package, giving them the right to buy company stock at a predetermined price.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign currency derivatives by sector notional value of contracts with nonresidents
structure:Code.common:Description: The total notional value of foreign currency derivative contracts with nonresidents, categorized by sector.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign currency derivatives by sector notional value of contracts with nonresidents total
structure:Code.common:Description: The aggregate notional value of all foreign currency derivative contracts with nonresidents, categorized by sector.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial derivatives (other than reserves) and employee stock options: official
structure:Code.common:Description: Negotiable financial instruments linked to another specific financial instrument, indicator, or commodity, through which specific risks (e.g., interest rate risk, foreign exchange risk, equity and commodity price risk, credit risk) can be traded in their own right in financial markets. Financial derivatives excluding those held as reserves and employee stock options.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial derivatives (other than reserves) and employee stock options: unofficial
structure:Code.common:Description: Negotiable financial instruments linked to another specific financial instrument, indicator, or commodity, through which specific risks (e.g., interest rate risk, foreign exchange risk, equity and commodity price risk, credit risk) can be traded in their own right in financial markets. Financial derivatives excluding those held as reserves and employee stock options.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other accounts receivable/payable
structure:Code.common:Description: Accounts that are either receivable or payable but not classified under specific categories like trade receivables/payables or loans.

structure:Code.common:Name: Trade credits and advances
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial claims arising from the direct extension of credit by suppliers to buyers for the purchase of goods and services, and advances for work in progress.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other accounts receivable/payable: excluding trade credits and advances
structure:Code.common:Description: Miscellaneous other items receivable or payable such as liabilities for taxes, emissions permits, cash collateral received by nondeposit-taking corporations (except those for reverse transactions), purchase and sale of securities, securities lending fees, gold loan fees, crypto lending fees, wages and salaries, dividends, and social contributions that have accrued but have not yet been paid. It also includes prepayments of those items.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other accounts payable
structure:Code.common:Description: Accounts that are payable but not classified under specific categories like trade payables or loans.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other accounts receivable
structure:Code.common:Description: Accounts that are receivable but not classified under specific categories like trade receivables or loans.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial claims and gold bullion held by monetary authorities as a reserve asset.

structure:Code.common:Name: All financial instruments
structure:Code.common:Description: The full range of financial contracts made between institutional units. They may be recorded on the balance sheet or off the balance sheet (e.g., constructive and contingent assets and liabilities).

structure:Code.common:Name: Overdue obligations to the IMF
structure:Code.common:Description: 1 fund shares, insurance, pension and standardized guarantee schemes, financial derivatives, 2 and other accounts receivable/payable.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net implicit obligations for social security benefits
structure:Code.common:Description: The net present value of future obligations for social security benefits that are not explicitly recorded as liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt Instruments: of which debt securities
structure:Code.common:Description: A specific category of debt instruments that are classified as debt securities.

structure:Code.common:Name: External debt
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt a country owes to foreign creditors.

structure:Code.common:Name: External debt: arrears
structure:Code.common:Description: The portion of external debt that is overdue and unpaid.

structure:Code.common:Name: External debt: debtor based
structure:Code.common:Description: External debt classified based on the identity of the debtor.

structure:Code.common:Name: External debt: debtor based, official
structure:Code.common:Description: External debt classified based on the identity of the official debtor, such as the government.

structure:Code.common:Name: External debt: official
structure:Code.common:Description: External debt that is owed by official entities, such as governments or central banks.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross external debt
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt that a country owes to foreign creditors.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial investment
structure:Code.common:Description: Allocation of money with the expectation of a financial return.

structure:Code.common:Name: Arrears
structure:Code.common:Description: Unpaid overdue amounts, such as interest or principal on loans or debt securities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Accumulation of arrears on original interest/coupon from debt instruments
structure:Code.common:Description: The accumulation of unpaid original interest or coupon payments on debt instruments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Accumulation of arrears on penalty interest from debt instruments
structure:Code.common:Description: The accumulation of unpaid penalty interest on debt instruments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Accumulation of arrears on principal from debt instruments
structure:Code.common:Description: The accumulation of unpaid principal amounts on debt instruments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Accumulation of arrears on other debt instruments
structure:Code.common:Description: The accumulation of unpaid amounts on various types of debt instruments, excluding the original interest or coupon payments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Arrears on original interest
structure:Code.common:Description: Unpaid overdue original interest on loans or debt securities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Arrears on penalty interest
structure:Code.common:Description: Unpaid overdue penalty interest on loans or debt securities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Arrears on principal
structure:Code.common:Description: Unpaid overdue principal amounts on loans or debt securities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Reserve position in the IMF
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve position in the IMF is the sum of a member’s reserve tranche position and any indebtedness of the IMF in the General Resources Account (GRA) that is readily available to the member to meet balance of payments financing needs. The amount is as reported by the reporting economy.

structure:Code.common:Name: Reserve position in the IMF (adjusted using IMF records)
structure:Code.common:Description: The reserve position in the IMF, adjusted according to IMF records, reflecting a member country's financial commitment to the IMF.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt instruments
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt instruments are financial instruments that require the payment of principal and/or interest at some point(s) in the future. Debt instruments consist of SDRs, currency and deposits, debt securities, loans, insurance technical reserves, pension and related entitlements, provision for calls under standardized guarantees, and other accounts receivable/payable. In the external accounts, trade credit and advances are in a separate category from other accounts receivable/payable and are also included in debt instruments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt instruments
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt instruments are financial instruments that require the payment of principal and/or interest at some point(s) in the future. Debt instruments consist of SDRs, currency and deposits, debt securities, loans, insurance technical reserves, pension and related entitlements, provision for calls under standardized guarantees, and other accounts receivable/payable. In the external accounts, trade credit and advances are in a separate category from other accounts receivable/payable and are also included in debt instruments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt instruments (excluding exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt instruments that exclude those related to exceptional financing arrangements.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other debt instruments
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt instruments not classified under any other specific category.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other debt instruments: new drawings / deposits
structure:Code.common:Description: New drawings or deposits under other debt instruments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other debt instruments: new drawings / deposits on behalf of authorities
structure:Code.common:Description: New drawings or deposits under other debt instruments made on behalf of authorities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other debt instruments: prepayment
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt instruments that include prepayments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Accumulation of arrears on debt instruments
structure:Code.common:Description: The process of accumulating unpaid interest or principal on debt instruments that are past due.

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary financial assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial assets that are in the form of money or can be easily converted to money.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other liabilities/assets (GFS concept)
structure:Code.common:Description: Other liabilities or assets according to the Government Finance Statistics (GFS) concept.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net external debt
structure:Code.common:Description: Amount of debt held by an institutional unit after subtracting the value of financial assets it holds corresponding to debt liabilities of other institutional units

structure:Code.common:Name: Net external debt: creditor based
structure:Code.common:Description: The net external debt categorized based on the creditor.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net external debt: commercial banks, creditor based
structure:Code.common:Description: The net external debt owed by commercial banks, categorized based on the creditor.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net external debt: commercial banks
structure:Code.common:Description: The net external debt owed by commercial banks.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net external debt: commercial banks, debtor based
structure:Code.common:Description: The net external debt owed by commercial banks, categorized based on the debtor.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net external debt (official): debtor based
structure:Code.common:Description: The net external debt owed by official entities, categorized based on the debtor.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net external debt: arrears
structure:Code.common:Description: The portion of net external debt that is overdue and unpaid.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net external debt (official)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net external debt owed by official entities, such as governments or central banks.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net external debt (official): creditor based
structure:Code.common:Description: The net external debt owed by official entities, categorized based on the creditor.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net external debt: private debt
structure:Code.common:Description: Other categories of net external debt owed by private sector entities.

structure:Code.common:Name: WEO External Debt Indicators
structure:Code.common:Description: WEO External Debt Indicators.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net external debt: debt to official creditors
structure:Code.common:Description: The net external debt owed to official creditors, such as governments or international organizations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net external debt: debt to private creditors
structure:Code.common:Description: The net external debt owed to private sector creditors.

structure:Code.common:Name: Equity and debt instruments (BOP methodology)
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial instruments representing ownership interest (equity) and debt obligations as defined in the latest balance of payments manual.

structure:Code.common:Name: Investment fund shares/units: life insurance, and pension schemes
structure:Code.common:Description: Shares or units in investment funds that are part of life insurance and pension schemes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt (non-standard definition)
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt defined in a manner that does not conform to standard definitions, potentially including additional or alternative criteria.

structure:Code.common:Name: Assets in remaining net flows of households deprecated
structure:Code.common:Description: The value of household assets, excluding any depreciated amounts.

structure:Code.common:Name: Securities (equity, investment fund shares/units and debt securities)
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial instruments representing ownership in a company (equity), pooled investments (investment fund shares/units), and borrowings (debt securities) that provide returns to the holder.

structure:Code.common:Name: Securities other than shares
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial instruments representing ownership that do not constitute shares, such as bonds and notes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other reserve assets (currency, deposits, securities, financial derivatives and other claims)
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve assets that include currency, deposits, securities, financial derivatives, and other claims.

structure:Code.common:Name: Securities; currency and deposits
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial instruments that include both securities and currency and deposits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other reserve assets (financial derivatives, loans to non-banks and other)
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve assets that include financial derivatives, loans to non-bank entities, and other assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Reserve assets other than gold, SDRs, IMF reserve position, currency, deposits, securities, financial derivatives and loans (to non-banks)
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve assets held by a country that exclude gold, Special Drawing Rights (SDRs), IMF reserve positions, currency, deposits, securities, financial derivatives, and loans made to non-bank entities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Reserve-related liabilities (RRL) to nonresidents
structure:Code.common:Description: Liabilities related to reserve assets owed to nonresidents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Credit and loans from the IMF: reserve-related liabilities (RRL) to nonresidents
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve-related liabilities owed to nonresidents arising from credit and loans provided by the IMF.

structure:Code.common:Name: Deposits: reserve-related liabilities (RRL) to nonresidents
structure:Code.common:Description: Deposits that are reserve-related liabilities owed to nonresidents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt securities: reserve-related liabilities (RRL) to nonresidents
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt securities that are reserve-related liabilities owed to nonresidents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Loans: reserve-related liabilities (RRL) to nonresidents
structure:Code.common:Description: Loans that are reserve-related liabilities owed to nonresidents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Loans, Other (reserve-related liabilities (RRL) to nonresidents)
structure:Code.common:Description: Loans that are reserve-related liabilities owed to nonresidents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Loans, Repo Loans (reserve-related liabilities (RRL) to nonresidents)
structure:Code.common:Description: Loans that are reserve-related liabilities owed to nonresidents, specifically those involved in repurchase agreements (repo loans).

structure:Code.common:Name: Other short-term foreign currency liabilities to nonresidents: reserve-related liabilities (RRL) to nonresidents
structure:Code.common:Description: Short-term foreign currency liabilities to nonresidents that are classified as reserve-related liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other reserve assets: currency and deposits
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve assets in the form of currency and deposits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other reserve assets: currency and deposits claims on monetary authorities
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve assets in the form of currency and deposits with claims on monetary authorities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other reserve assets: currency and deposits claims on other entities
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve assets in the form of currency and deposits with claims on entities other than monetary authorities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other reserve assets: securities
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve assets in the form of securities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other reserve assets: equity and investment fund shares
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve assets in the form of equity and investment fund shares.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other reserve assets: equity and investment fund shares, of which securities under repo for cash collateral
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve assets in the form of equity and investment fund shares, specifically those under repurchase agreements (repos) for cash collateral.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other reserve assets: financial derivatives
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve assets in the form of financial derivatives.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other reserve assets: other claims
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve assets that include other types of claims not classified under specific categories.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other reserve assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve assets not classified under specific categories.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other foreign currency assets not included in reserve assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Foreign currency assets, including securities, deposits, loans, financial derivatives, and gold, that are not part of official reserve assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Currency and deposits: loans and securities
structure:Code.common:Description: Currency and deposits that are invested in loans and securities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other, mainly inter-company loans
structure:Code.common:Description: Loans that are primarily inter-company but not classified under specific categories.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign exchange
structure:Code.common:Description: The global marketplace for buying and selling national currencies.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities or debt to official creditors
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial obligations owed to official entities such as governments or international organizations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net worth
structure:Code.common:Description: The total assets minus total liabilities of an entity.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net worth excluding land, natural resources and pension liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: The total assets minus total liabilities, excluding land, natural resources, and pension liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Maastricht debt
structure:Code.common:Description: The total public sector debt of European Union member states, as defined by the Maastricht Treaty.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D4)
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities, including various economic flows and transactions, as categorized under classification D4.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D1) debt liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities categorized under classification D1, specifically including D1 debt liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Holding gains and losses gross debt (D1) holding gains and losses (D1) debt liabilities holding gains and losses
structure:Code.common:Description: The increase or decrease in the value of gross debt (D1) and (D1) debt liabilities due to changes in market prices.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D4) other economic flows, (D1) debt liabilities other economic flows
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities categorized under classification (D1), including other economic flows and (D1) debt liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D1) other volume changes, (D1) debt liabilities other volume changes
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities categorized under classification (D1), including other volume changes and D1 debt liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D1) transactions, (D1) debt liabilities transactions
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities categorized under classification (D1), including transactions and D1 debt liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D2), debt liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities categorized under classification (D2), specifically including (D2) debt liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Holding gains and losses gross debt (D2) holding gains and losses (D2) debt liabilities holding gains and losses
structure:Code.common:Description: The increase or decrease in the value of gross debt (D2) and (D2) debt liabilities due to changes in market prices.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D2) other economic flows, (D2) debt liabilities other economic flows
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities categorized under classification (D2), including other economic flows and (D2) debt liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D2) other volume changes, (D2) debt liabilities other volume changes
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities categorized under classification (D2), including other volume changes and (D2) debt liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D2) transactions, (D2) debt liabilities transactions
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities categorized under classification (D2), including transactions and (D2) debt liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D3) debt liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities categorized under classification D3, specifically including D3 debt liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Holding gains and losses gross debt (D3) holding gains and losses (D3) debt liabilities holding gains and losses
structure:Code.common:Description: The increase or decrease in the value of gross debt (D3) and (D3) debt liabilities due to changes in market prices.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D3) other economic flows, (D3) debt liabilities other economic flows
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities categorized under classification (D3), including other economic flows and (D)3 debt liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D3) other volume changes, (D3) debt liabilities other volume changes
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities categorized under classification (D3), including other volume changes and (D3) debt liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D3) transactions, (D3) debt liabilities transactions
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities categorized under classification (D3), including transactions and (D)3 debt liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D4), net of currency and deposits assets
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities categorized under classification D4, net of currency and deposit assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D1), net of currency and deposits assets, (D1) debt liabilities net of currency and deposits assets
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities categorized under classification (D1), net of currency and deposit assets, specifically including (D1) debt liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D2), net of currency and deposits assets, (D2) debt liabilities net of currency and deposits assets
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities categorized under classification (D2), net of currency and deposit assets, specifically including (D2) debt liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D3), net of currency and deposits assets, (D3) debt liabilities net of currency and deposits assets
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities categorized under classification (D3), net of currency and deposit assets, specifically including (D3) debt liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross debt (D4) other economic flows
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt liabilities categorized under classification D4, including other economic flows.

structure:Code.common:Name: Guaranteed Debt (at Market Value)
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt that is backed by a guarantee and valued at its current market price.

structure:Code.common:Name: Memo: Privatization proceeds allocated to redemption of debt (GFS concept)
structure:Code.common:Description: Proceeds from privatization allocated to reduce debt, as recorded in Government Finance Statistics (GFS).

structure:Code.common:Name: Memo: Universal Mobile Telecommunications System proceeds allocated to redemption of debt (GFS concept)
structure:Code.common:Description: Proceeds from the Universal Mobile Telecommunications System allocated to reduce debt, as recorded in Government Finance Statistics (GFS).

structure:Code.common:Name: Government gross debt per national definition
structure:Code.common:Description: The total amount of government debt calculated according to the national definition.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gold
structure:Code.common:Description: A precious metal held as a store of value and often used as a reserve asset by central banks. This includes physical gold in the form of bars, coins, and other forms.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gold holdings
structure:Code.common:Description: The total amount of gold held by an entity, including both monetary and non-monetary gold. This may include physical gold, gold deposits, and other forms of gold ownership.

structure:Code.common:Name: International Investment Position
structure:Code.common:Description: A financial statement that shows the value of a country's external financial assets and liabilities at a specific point in time.

structure:Code.common:Name: SDR Allocation, escrow account
structure:Code.common:Description: SDRs allocated as part of a special allocation to participants with overdue obligations to the IMF are deposited and held in an escrow account within the SDR Department and released to the participants on settlement of all overdue obligations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Outstanding Purchase (GRA)
structure:Code.common:Description: IMF member’s outstanding purchases of Fund resources through the General Resources Agreement (GRA), the counterparts of which are increases in the member’s domestic currency liabilities to the Fund.

structure:Code.common:Name: IMF Quota
structure:Code.common:Description: Refers to the financial contribution made by a member country to the IMF as a part of its membership in the organization. It consists of two components. i) foreign exchange component (25 percent) which a member is required to pay in SDRs or in foreign currencies acceptable to the IMF; and ii) domestic currency component (75 percent) which is payable in the member’s own currency at a designated depository, normally the member’s central bank.

structure:Code.common:Name: Reserve tranche position
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve tranche position in the IMF represents the member’s unconditional drawing right on the IMF, created by the foreign exchange portion of the quota subscription, plus increases (decreases) through the IMF’s sale (repurchase) of the members’ currency to meet the demand for use of IMF resources by other members in need of balance of payments financing.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial obligations that an entity owes to others.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities excluding pension liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial obligations excluding those related to pension benefits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Buildings other than dwellings (net)
structure:Code.common:Description: The value of non-residential buildings after accounting for disposals or depreciation.

structure:Code.common:Name: Machinery and equipment
structure:Code.common:Description: Physical assets used in the operation of a business, including tools, machinery, and equipment.

structure:Code.common:Name: Machinery and equipment (net)
structure:Code.common:Description: The value of machinery and equipment after accounting for depreciation or disposals.

structure:Code.common:Name: Weapons systems (net)
structure:Code.common:Description: The value of weapons systems after accounting for depreciation or consumption.

structure:Code.common:Name: Fixed assets, acquisitions
structure:Code.common:Description: The total value of fixed assets acquired during the accounting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Fixed assets, disposals
structure:Code.common:Description: The total value of fixed assets disposed of during the accounting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Fixed assets (acquisitions less disposals)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net value of fixed assets acquired minus those disposed of during the accounting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other fixed assets (acquisitions less disposals)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net value of other fixed assets after accounting for acquisitions and disposals.

structure:Code.common:Name: Inventories by type of inventory (net)
structure:Code.common:Description: The value of inventories categorized by type after accounting for depreciation or disposals.

structure:Code.common:Name: Valuables, acquisitions (net of consumption of fixed capital)
structure:Code.common:Description: The acquisitions of valuable items after accounting for the consumption of fixed capital.

structure:Code.common:Name: Valuables, disposals
structure:Code.common:Description: The disposals of valuable items.

structure:Code.common:Name: Valuables (acquisitions less disposals)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net acquisitions of valuable items, such as precious metals, stones, and art, after accounting for disposals.

structure:Code.common:Name: Land (gross)
structure:Code.common:Description: The total value of land before accounting for any depreciation or disposals.

structure:Code.common:Name: Land (acquisitions less disposals)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net value of land acquired minus land disposed of during the accounting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Mineral and energy reserves (gross)
structure:Code.common:Description: The total value of mineral and energy reserves before accounting for extraction or usage.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other naturally occurring assets (acquisitions less disposals)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net value of other naturally occurring assets after accounting for acquisitions and disposals.

structure:Code.common:Name: Subsoil Assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Natural resources found below the earth's surface, such as minerals and fossil fuels.

structure:Code.common:Name: Intangible non-produced assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Non-physical assets that have not been produced, such as patents, trademarks, and goodwill.

structure:Code.common:Name: Non-produced non-financial assets (acquisitions less disposals)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net value of acquisitions of non-produced non-financial assets after accounting for disposals.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net debt
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt minus financial assets that can be used to repay that debt.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net debt (D4)
structure:Code.common:Description: The total debt classified under category D4, net of financial assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net incurrence of domestic liabilities (adjustment)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net increase in domestic liabilities after adjustments for accounting discrepancies.

structure:Code.common:Name: Nonfinancial assets other than inventories, disposals
structure:Code.common:Description: The total value of disposals of nonfinancial assets other than inventories.

structure:Code.common:Name: All non-financial assets (gross)
structure:Code.common:Description: The total value of all non-financial assets before accounting for disposals or depreciation.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net incurrence liabilities (adjusted using Fund records)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net incurrence of liabilities represents the difference between taking on new liabilities less the retirement of liabilities. Country data adjusted using Fund records.

structure:Code.common:Name: Nonproduced assets other than inventories, acquisitions
structure:Code.common:Description: The net value of acquisitions of nonproduced assets other than inventories.

structure:Code.common:Name: All non-financial assets, acquisitions less disposals
structure:Code.common:Description: The net value of acquisitions minus disposals of non-financial assets during the accounting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Acquisitions/Disposals (net) of nonproduced nonfinancial assets
structure:Code.common:Description: The net value of purchases minus disposals of nonproduced assets, such as land and natural resources, during the accounting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Acquisitions (net): nonproduced assets
structure:Code.common:Description: The purchases of nonproduced assets, such as land and natural resources, during the accounting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Disposals, nonproduced nonfinancial assets
structure:Code.common:Description: The sale or disposal of nonproduced assets, such as land or natural resources.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross investment in nonfinancial assets
structure:Code.common:Description: The total investment in assets that are not financial in nature, such as property, plant, and equipment.

structure:Code.common:Name: Sales of non-financial assets (net)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net value of sales of non-financial assets after accounting for purchases and disposals.

structure:Code.common:Name: Reserve Assets, Not in SDR basket
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve Assets, not included in the basket of currencies used to value Special Drawing Rights (SDRs).

structure:Code.common:Name: Net (excluding exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net amount, excluding any transactions related to exceptional financing.

structure:Code.common:Name: Non-financial assets, acquisitions less disposals (includes total produced fixed assets and land underlying dwellings)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net value of acquisitions of nonfinancial assets, including produced fixed assets and land underlying dwellings, after accounting for disposals.

structure:Code.common:Name: Nonfinancial assets other than inventories, acquisitions (net of CFC)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net value of acquisitions of nonfinancial assets other than inventories, after accounting for consumption of fixed capital (CFC).

structure:Code.common:Name: Buildings and Structures
structure:Code.common:Description: Physical structures, including residential and non-residential buildings and infrastructure.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other Fixed Assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Fixed assets not classified under specific categories like buildings, machinery, or equipment.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: The total external liabilities under the functional category “Other Investment,” for which data reported by economies have been adjusted using IMF accounting records (e.g., for SDR holdings and allocations, reserve position in the Fund, and IMF loans).

structure:Code.common:Name: Other non-produced assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Non-produced assets not classified under specific categories.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other produced assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Produced assets not classified under specific categories.

structure:Code.common:Name: Permits to use natural resources
structure:Code.common:Description: Official permissions granted to use natural resources.

structure:Code.common:Name: Publicly guaranteed debt
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt that is guaranteed by a public entity, such as a government.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities or debt to private institutions
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial obligations owed to private sector entities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Stock-flow discrepancy: D1 debt liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: Discrepancies between stock and flow data related to (D1) debt liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Stock-flow discrepancy: financial assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Discrepancies between stock and flow data related to financial assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Stock-flow discrepancy: liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: Discrepancies between stock and flow data related to liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Stock-flow discrepancy: nonfinancial assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Discrepancies between stock and flow data related to nonfinancial assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Total assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Credit and loans with the IMF: other than reserves
structure:Code.common:Description: Credit and loans provided by the IMF that are not related to reserve assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Use of IMF credit (GRA)
structure:Code.common:Description: Total value of credit and loans outstanding with the IMF by IMF member countries.

structure:Code.common:Name: Outstanding loans from IMF (PRGT)
structure:Code.common:Description: Outstanding loans from the IMF represent the aggregate sum of financial assistance provided by the International Monetary Fund to member countries, which have not yet been fully reimbursed. These loans are extended to countries experiencing economic challenges, aiming to stabilize their economies and restore sustainable growth. The repayment of these loans is typically subject to negotiated terms and conditions, including interest rates and repayment schedules

structure:Code.common:Name: Money market instruments
structure:Code.common:Description: Short-term financial instruments that are highly liquid and low-risk, such as treasury bills and commercial paper.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total outlays (adjustment)
structure:Code.common:Description: Adjustments made to total outlays to account for specific factors or discrepancies.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total investment
structure:Code.common:Description: The total external asset position in portfolio investment, covering all categories of financial instruments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Use of IMF Credit and Loans
structure:Code.common:Description: The Use of Fund Credit and Loans (UFC) refers to the allocation and utilization of financial assistance (loans and credit lines) extended by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) to its member countries. This encompasses the deployment of IMF funds by member countries to address diverse economic needs, including balance of payments deficits, currency stabilization efforts, and implementation of structural reforms

structure:Code.common:Name: Total
structure:Code.common:Description: The sum of all relevant components or categories.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities to foreign banks
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial obligations owed to banking institutions located in foreign countries.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities to official creditors
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial obligations owed to official entities such as foreign governments, central banks, or international organizations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities to other sectors
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial obligations owed to entities in sectors other than banks or official creditors, such as private corporations, households, or other non-financial institutions located in foreign countries.

structure:Code.common:Name: Official liabilities (including use of Fund credit)
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial obligations owed to official creditors, including liabilities arising from the use of credit provided by the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

structure:Code.common:Name: Private liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial obligations owed to private sector entities, such as corporations, households, or other non-official institutions located in foreign countries.

structure:Code.common:Name: Loans, trade credit and deposits
structure:Code.common:Description: The combined value of loans, trade credits and advances, and deposits held by an entity. Loans represent borrowed funds, trade credits represent short-term financing from suppliers, and deposits are funds placed with financial institutions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial assets, external
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial assets held by an entity that represent claims on non-residents. These assets can include foreign currency holdings, deposits in foreign banks, holdings of foreign securities, and other claims on foreign entities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign assets of the Central Bank
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial assets held by the central bank of a country that represent claims on non-residents. These assets are typically part of the country's official reserves and may include foreign currency holdings, gold, and SDRs.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign liabilities of the Central Bank
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial obligations owed by the central bank of a country to non-residents. These liabilities may include deposits from foreign central banks, borrowings from international organizations, or other obligations to foreign entities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Bank debt
structure:Code.common:Description: Loans or other debt instruments issued by a bank that are held as assets by another entity.

structure:Code.common:Name: External debt: Government (official)
structure:Code.common:Description: The portion of a country's external debt that is owed by the government or other official entities, such as central banks or government agencies.

structure:Code.common:Name: External debt: Government (official)
structure:Code.common:Description: The portion of a country's external debt that is owed by the government or other official entities, such as central banks or government agencies.

structure:Code.common:Name: Nonfinancial assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Tangible and intangible economic resources owned by an entity that are not financial assets. These include fixed assets like buildings, machinery, and land, as well as inventories, valuables, and non-produced assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: The total value of all financial obligations owed by an entity to other entities. These obligations represent claims held by others against the entity and may include loans, debt securities, accounts payable, and other forms of debt.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total liabilities, external
structure:Code.common:Description: The total value of all financial obligations owed by an entity to non-residents. These obligations represent claims held by foreign entities against the reporting entity and may include loans, debt securities, accounts payable, and other forms of debt owed to foreign creditors.

structure:Code.common:Name: Lending to the IMF (GRA)
structure:Code.common:Description: Lending by a member country to the International Monetary Fund (IMF) through the General Resources Account (GRA). This lending contributes to the IMF's resources for providing financial assistance to member countries facing balance of payments problems.

structure:Code.common:Name: Outstanding IMF loans (PRGT)
structure:Code.common:Description: The outstanding balance of loans provided by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) through the Poverty Reduction and Growth Trust (PRGT). The PRGT provides concessional loans to low-income countries to support their poverty reduction and economic growth efforts.

structure:Code.common:Name: SDR Allocation
structure:Code.common:Description: SDR Allocations are a distribution of SDRs to members by decision of the IMF. Allocations of SDRs are made to participants in the SDR department (currently, all IMF members are participants) in proportion to their quotas in the IMF.

structure:Code.common:Name: Outstanding Purchase (GRA)
structure:Code.common:Description: IMF member’s outstanding purchases of Fund resources through the General Resources Agreement (GRA), the counterparts of which are increases in the member’s domestic currency liabilities to the Fund.

structure:Code.common:Name: Outstanding IMF Loans (RST)
structure:Code.common:Description: The outstanding balance of loans provided by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) through the Resilience and Sustainability Trust (RST). The RST provides loans to IMF members to support their efforts to adapt to and mitigate climate change.

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary gold: gold bullion
structure:Code.common:Description: Gold in the form of bars or ingots held as a reserve asset.

structure:Code.common:Name: Forward type
structure:Code.common:Description: Forwards are unconditional contracts by which two counterparties agree to buy or sell a specified quantity of an underlying item (financial or nonfinancial) at an agreed-upon contract price (the strike price) on a specified date. Forward contracts are traded over-the-counter.

structure:Code.common:Name: Unallocated gold accounts
structure:Code.common:Description: Unallocated gold accounts.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt instruments other than insurance, pension, and standardized schemes
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt instruments other than insurance, pension, and standardized schemes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Listed shares
structure:Code.common:Description: Equity securities listed on an exchange (also known as quoted shares).

structure:Code.common:Name: Unlisted shares
structure:Code.common:Description: Equity securities that are not listed on an exchange (also known as unquoted shares).

structure:Code.common:Name: Other claims (other reserve assets)
structure:Code.common:Description: Other claims (other reserve assets).

structure:Code.common:Name: Debt instruments other than SDRs, insurance, pension, and standardized schemes
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt instruments other than SDRs, insurance, pension, and standardized schemes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Portfolio Investment Assets by Economy of Holder and Issuer
structure:Code.common:Description: Portfolio Investment Assets by Economy of Holder and Issuer.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total, short or negative positions
structure:Code.common:Description: Short position is a position when an institutional unit sells securities for which it is not the economic owner.

structure:Code.common:Name: Outward Direct Investment
structure:Code.common:Description: Outward investment position relates to direct investment assets less liabilities between resident direct investors and their direct investment enterprises. It also covers direct investment assets less liabilities between resident and nonresident fellow enterprises if the ultimate controlling parent is resident.

structure:Code.common:Name: Outward less Inward Direct Investment Position
structure:Code.common:Description: Outward less Inward Direct Investment position for all instruments (used in CDIS)

structure:Code.common:Name: Outward Direct investment Between Fellow Enterprises
structure:Code.common:Description: Outward investment position between fellow enterprises relates to direct investment assets less liabilities between resident and nonresident fellow enterprise if the ultimate controlling parent is resident. Fellow enterprises are enterprises under the control or influence, either directly or indirectly, of the same direct investor, but neither of the enterprises controls or influences the other enterprise.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities, adjustment
structure:Code.common:Description: Liabilities, adjustment.

structure:Code.common:Name: Bitcoin
structure:Code.common:Description: Bitcoin (BTC) is a decentralized digital currency, without a central bank or single administrator, that can be sent from user to user on the peer-to-peer bitcoin network without the need for intermediaries. 1

structure:Code.common:Name: Securities under repo for cash collateral
structure:Code.common:Description: Securities under repo for cash collateral.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net International Investment Position
structure:Code.common:Description: A financial statement that shows the value of a country's external financial assets and liabilities at a specific point in time.

structure:Code.common:Name: Currency and deposits, Claims on other entities
structure:Code.common:Description: Monetary assets held in the form of currency or in deposit accounts with financial institutions, claims on other entities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Currency and deposits, Claims on monetary authorities
structure:Code.common:Description: Monetary assets held in the form of currency or in deposit accounts with financial institutions, claims on monetary authorities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Options
structure:Code.common:Description: Options

structure:Code.common:Name: Gold at 35 SDRs per ounce
structure:Code.common:Description: Gold at 35 SDRs per ounce.

structure:Code.common:Name: Nonfinancial assets excluding land and natural resources
structure:Code.common:Description: Economic resources owned by an entity, excluding land and natural resources.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gold, volume
structure:Code.common:Description: Gold, volume.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gold at national valuation
structure:Code.common:Description: Gold at national valuation.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial derivatives and employee stock options
structure:Code.common:Description: Negotiable financial instruments linked to another specific financial instrument, indicator, or commodity, through which specific risks (e.g., interest rate risk, foreign exchange risk, equity and commodity price risk, credit risk) can be traded in their own right in financial markets. Financial derivatives and employee stock options.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial assets (adjustment)
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial assets (adjustment).

structure:Code.common:Name: Major improvements non-produced assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Major improvements non-produced assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Reserve Assets included in SDR basket
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve Assets included in SDR basket.

structure:Code.common:Description: Land.

structure:Code.common:Description: Fixed assets.

structure:Code.common:Description: Non-produced non-financial assets.

structure:Code.common:Description: Valuables.

structure:Code.common:Description: Weapons systems.

structure:Code.common:Description: Other fixed assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Inventories by type of inventory
structure:Code.common:Description: Inventories by type of inventory.

structure:Code.common:Description: Mineral and energy reserves.

structure:Code.common:Description: Other naturally occurring assets.

structure:Codelist.common:Name: Organization
structure:Codelist.common:Description: This codelist identifies and categorizes institutions relevant to economic, financial, and statistical data, providing standardized codes and corresponding names. It includes international organizations, central banks, and government institutions involved in data collection and dissemination.
