structure:Code.common:Description: Direct investment by direct investment enterprises in direct investors (reverse investment)

structure:Code.common:Name: Direct investment excluding direct investment between fellow enterprises
structure:Code.common:Description: Direct investment, excluding those between fellow enterprises

structure:Code.common:Name: Direct Investment, net acquisition of financial assets less net incurrence of liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: The net change in financial assets and liabilities resulting from direct investment transactions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Direct investor in direct investment enterprises
structure:Code.common:Description: Direct investment by direct investors in direct investment enterprises.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial derivatives (other than reserves) and employee stock options (official)
structure:Code.common:Description: Official financial instruments linked to other specific instruments, indicators, or commodities, and employee stock options provided as a form of remuneration.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial derivatives (other than reserves) and employee stock options (unofficial)
structure:Code.common:Description: Unofficial financial instruments linked to other specific instruments, indicators, or commodities, and employee stock options provided as a form of remuneration.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial derivatives and employee stock options
structure:Code.common:Description: Negotiable financial instruments and employee stock options that are linked to other specific financial instruments, indicators, or commodities, through which specific risks can be traded in their own right.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign direct investment and equity security liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: Liabilities arising from foreign direct investment and cross-border transactions involving equity securities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Inward direct investment
structure:Code.common:Description: Direct investment where the entity controlling or influencing the investment decision is resident abroad.

structure:Code.common:Name: Inward direct investment: debt-creating liabilities to foreign direct investors
structure:Code.common:Description: Inward direct investment that results in debt obligations to foreign direct investors.

structure:Code.common:Name: Inward direct investment, excluding debt-creating liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: Inward direct investment that does not result in debt obligations to foreign direct investors.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net investment in foreign portfolio assets
structure:Code.common:Description: The net value of investments in foreign portfolio assets, after accounting for acquisitions and disposals.

structure:Code.common:Name: Not allocated/unspecified
structure:Code.common:Description: Investment or assets that are not specifically categorized or detailed.

structure:Code.common:Name: Not applicable
structure:Code.common:Description: Functional category is not applicable in the context.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other investment (official)
structure:Code.common:Description: Other investments made by official institutions, including loans, deposits, and trade credits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other investment (private)
structure:Code.common:Description: Other investments made by private entities, including loans, deposits, and trade credits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other investment (unofficial)
structure:Code.common:Description: Other investments made by unofficial entities, including loans, deposits, and trade credits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other investment: loans, deposits, and trade credits
structure:Code.common:Description: A residual investment category that includes positions and transactions in loans, deposits, and trade credits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other investment: loans, deposits, and trade credits (official)
structure:Code.common:Description: Official positions and transactions in loans, deposits, and trade credits categorized as other investment.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other investment: loans, deposits, and trade credits (unofficial)
structure:Code.common:Description: Unofficial positions and transactions in loans, deposits, and trade credits categorized as other investment.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other investment: liabilities to foreign banks
structure:Code.common:Description: Liabilities arising from other investment transactions owed to foreign banks.

structure:Code.common:Name: Outward direct investment
structure:Code.common:Description: Direct investment where the entity controlling or influencing the investment decision is resident in the domestic economy

structure:Code.common:Name: Portfolio Investment (official)
structure:Code.common:Description: Cross-border transactions and positions in debt or equity securities made by official institutions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Portfolio Investment (private)
structure:Code.common:Description: Cross-border transactions and positions in debt or equity securities made by private entities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Portfolio Investment (unofficial)
structure:Code.common:Description: Cross-border transactions and positions in debt or equity securities made by unofficial entities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Portfolio investment by type of creditor
structure:Code.common:Description: Classification of portfolio investment based on the type of creditor involved in the transactions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Portfolio investment liabilities to foreign banks
structure:Code.common:Description: Liabilities arising from portfolio investment transactions owed to foreign banks.

structure:Code.common:Name: Reserve assets, Reserve position in the IMF
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve assets including the country's position in the IMF, which can be used to meet balance of payments financing needs.

structure:Code.common:Name: Reserve assets, excluding monetary gold
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve assets excluding holdings of monetary gold.

structure:Code.common:Name: Reserve assets in SDR basket
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve assets that are part of the Special Drawing Rights (SDR) basket.

structure:Code.common:Name: Reserve assets: Special Drawing Rights (SDRs)
structure:Code.common:Description: International reserve assets created by the IMF to supplement member countries' official reserves.

structure:Code.common:Name: Reserves data template
structure:Code.common:Description: A standardized format for reporting and presenting reserve assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign currency reserves in convertible foreign currencies
structure:Code.common:Description: Foreign currency reserves in convertible foreign currencies

structure:Code.common:Name: Portfolio investment liabilities to official creditors
structure:Code.common:Description: Liabilities arising from portfolio investment transactions owed to official creditors.

structure:Code.common:Name: Portfolio investment liabilities to other creditors
structure:Code.common:Description: Liabilities arising from portfolio investment transactions owed to creditors other than foreign banks or official creditors.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other investment: liabilities to other sectors
structure:Code.common:Description: Liabilities arising from other investment transactions owed to other sectors.

structure:Code.common:Name: Reserve assets: Special Drawing Rights (SDRs), adjusted with IMF records
structure:Code.common:Description: Special Drawing Rights (SDRs) included in reserve assets, reflecting adjustments based on alignment with International Monetary Fund (IMF) records.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other Investment: liabilities to official creditors
structure:Code.common:Description: Other Investment: liabilities to official creditors

structure:Code.common:Name: Portfolio investment adjusted for liabilities constituting foreign authorities' reserves (LCFAR)
structure:Code.common:Description: Portfolio investment adjusted for liabilities constituting foreign authorities' reserves (LCFAR).

structure:Code.common:Name: Other investment adjusted for liabilities constituting foreign authorities' reserves (LCFAR)
structure:Code.common:Description: Other investment adjusted for liabilities constituting foreign authorities' reserves (LCFAR).

structure:Code.common:Name: Reserves minus liabilities constituting foreign authorities' reserves (LCFAR)
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserves minus liabilities constituting foreign authorities' reserves (LCFAR).

structure:Code.common:Name: Other investment, excluding exceptional financing
structure:Code.common:Description: Other investment, excluding exceptional financing.

structure:Code.common:Name: Portfolio investment, excluding exceptional financing
structure:Code.common:Description: Portfolio investment, excluding exceptional financing.

structure:Code.common:Name: Direct investment, excluding exceptional financing
structure:Code.common:Description: Direct investment, excluding exceptional financing.

structure:Code.common:Name: Reserve assets: Special Drawing Rights (SDRs) adjusted using IMF accounting records
structure:Code.common:Description: Reserve assets: Special Drawing Rights (SDRs) adjusted using IMF accounting records.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial derivatives and employee stock options (other than reserves)
structure:Code.common:Description: Negotiable financial instruments and employee stock options that are linked to other specific financial instruments, indicators, or commodities. Excludes reserve assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign exchange reserves that have been imputed
structure:Code.common:Description: Foreign Exchange Reserves (FXR) are reserve assets other than monetary gold, SDRs, and reserve position in the IMF. Reserve assets are external assets that are readily available to and controlled by monetary authorities for meeting balance of payments financing needs, for intervention in exchange markets to affect the currency exchange rate, and for other related purposes (such as maintaining confidence in the currency and the economy and serving as a basis for foreign borrowing). Reserve assets must be denominated and settled in foreign currency. This represents the foreign exchange reserves that have been imputed by IMF staff.

structure:Codelist.common:Name: Unit Multiplier
structure:Codelist.common:Description: This code list provides code values for indicating the magnitude in the units of measurement. More information about this code list and SDMX code lists in general (e.g. list of generic codes for expressing general concepts like "Total", "Unknown", etc.; syntaxes for the creation of further codes; general guidelines for the creation of SDMX code lists) can be found at this address: https://sdmx.org/?page_id=4345.

structure:Codelist.common:Name: Interest Rate types, terms and conditions
structure:Codelist.common:Description: A classification of interest rates based on their type (fixed or floating), terms (maturity), and other conditions (e.g., collateralization, reference rates).

structure:Code.common:Name: 3- or 6-month London interbank offered interest rate (LIBOR)
structure:Code.common:Description: The average interest rate, determined by a daily survey of major global banks, at which banks in London lend unsecured short-term funds to other banks in the London interbank market. The rate is quoted for various maturities, including 3- and 6-month periods.

structure:Code.common:Name: 3- or 6-month London interbank offered interest rate (LIBOR), real
structure:Code.common:Description: The 3- or 6-month LIBOR, adjusted for inflation, to reflect constant purchasing power. This is typically calculated by subtracting the expected inflation rate from the nominal LIBOR rate.

structure:Code.common:Name: 3-month bond yield (or nearest equivalent)
structure:Code.common:Description: The return on investment for a 3-month government bond or a bond of similar maturity.

structure:Code.common:Name: 3-month Euro Interbank offered rate (EURIBOR)
structure:Code.common:Description: The average unsecured interbank lending rate in the Euro area for a three-month maturity, based on daily bank submissions.

structure:Code.common:Name: 3-Month interbank rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The average interbank lending rate for a three-month maturity, based on daily bank submissions.

structure:Code.common:Name: 3-month London Interbank offered rate (LIBOR)
structure:Code.common:Description: The average unsecured interbank lending rate in London for a three-month maturity, based on daily submissions from major global banks.

structure:Code.common:Name: 6-month London interbank offered interest rate (LIBOR), real
structure:Code.common:Description: The 6-month LIBOR, adjusted for inflation, to reflect constant purchasing power. This is typically calculated by subtracting the expected inflation rate from the nominal LIBOR rate.

structure:Code.common:Name: 6-month London interbank offered interest rate (LIBOR), real, Archive
structure:Code.common:Description: The archived interest rate for real 6-month LIBOR.

structure:Code.common:Name: Average cost of funds
structure:Code.common:Description: The average interest rate that financial institutions pay to borrow money.

structure:Code.common:Name: Bond yield
structure:Code.common:Description: The rate of return implied by a bond’s price, coupon payments, and time to maturity.

structure:Code.common:Name: Central bank borrowing facility
structure:Code.common:Description: A facility through which financial institutions borrow funds from the central bank.

structure:Code.common:Name: Central bank certificates
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt securities issued by central banks.

structure:Code.common:Name: Certificates of deposit
structure:Code.common:Description: Time deposits issued by banks with a fixed maturity date and a specified interest rate.

structure:Code.common:Name: Corporate bond yield spread
structure:Code.common:Description: Yield difference between corporate and government bonds of similar maturity, expressed in standard deviation units.

structure:Code.common:Name: Corporate paper rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate on corporate paper.

structure:Code.common:Name: Deposit rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate paid by banks on funds deposited by account holders. This rate determines how much interest a depositor earns on their savings or deposit accounts.

structure:Code.common:Name: Deposit rate, overnight
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate paid by banks on deposits that are held for a single night. This rate applies to very short-term deposits, typically from one banking day to the next.

structure:Code.common:Name: Discount rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate charged by central banks on loans to commercial banks.

structure:Code.common:Name: EMBI Global - stripped spread
structure:Code.common:Description: The spread on emerging market bonds, adjusted for risk by stripping out risk-free components. One unit is equivalent to one standard deviation of standardized variable.

structure:Code.common:Name: Emerging market stock returns
structure:Code.common:Description: The returns on stocks from emerging markets. One unit is equivalent to one standard deviation of standardized variable.

structure:Code.common:Name: Euro system deposit facility rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate paid on deposits held at the central bank of the Eurozone by commercial banks.

structure:Code.common:Name: Government bond yields, medium term
structure:Code.common:Description: The annualized rate of return for government bonds with medium-term maturities (typically 3-10 years).

structure:Code.common:Name: Government bond yields
structure:Code.common:Description: The annualized rate of return for long-term debt securities issued by a government.

structure:Code.common:Name: Government securities: Treasury bills
structure:Code.common:Description: Short-term debt securities issued by a government.

structure:Code.common:Name: Government securities: Treasury bills, 3-month
structure:Code.common:Description: Short-term debt securities issued by a government with a maturity of 3 months.

structure:Code.common:Name: Government securities: Treasury bills, bond equivalent
structure:Code.common:Description: Treasury bills with yields expressed on a bond-equivalent basis.

structure:Code.common:Name: Government securities: Treasury bills, long-term
structure:Code.common:Description: Long-term debt securities issued by a government.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro area rates, New business: Deposits agreed maturity up to 1 year
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on new deposits with agreed maturities up to 1 year in the Euro area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro area rates, New Business: Deposits, households
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on new deposit accounts for households in the Euro area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro area rates, New Business: Deposits, non-financial corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on new deposit accounts for non-financial corporations in the Euro area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro area rates, New business: Loans consumption floating rate and up to 1 year
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on new household consumer loans with floating rates or initial rate fixation up to one year in the Euro area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro area rates, New business: Loans house purchase, over 5 years
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on new loans to households for house purchase in the Euro area with an initial rate fixation period of more than five years.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro area rates, New business: Loans other than bank overdrafts, over EUR 1 million, over 3 months and up to 1 year
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on new loans other than bank overdrafts over EUR 1 million, with initial rate fixation over three months and up to one year, in the Euro area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro area rates, New Business: Loans, House Purchase, households
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on new loan contracts to households for house purchase in the Euro area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro area rates, New Business: Loans, households
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on new loan contracts to households in the Euro area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro area rates, New Business: Loans, non-financial corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on new loan contracts to non-financial corporations in the Euro area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro area rates, Outstanding Amounts: Deposits agreed maturity up to 2 years
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on outstanding deposits with agreed maturities up to 2 years in the Euro area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro area rates, Outstanding Amounts: Deposits non-financial corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on outstanding deposit accounts for non-financial corporations in the Euro area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Inverted term spread
structure:Code.common:Description: A situation in which short-term interest rates exceed long-term interest rates. The indicator is expressed in standardized units, where one unit corresponds to one standard deviation from the historical mean.

structure:Code.common:Name: Key repurchase agreement rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The main interest rate applied to repurchase agreements in which a central bank purchases securities from financial institutions with a commitment to resell them at a later date.

structure:Code.common:Name: Lending rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate charged by banks on loans to borrowers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Lending rate: overnight
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate charged by banks on loans that are to be repaid the next day.

structure:Code.common:Name: London interbank offered rate
structure:Code.common:Description: Reference interest rate, calculated as a trimmed mean of daily submissions from a panel of major global banks, representing the rate at which those banks estimated they could borrow unsecured funds in the London interbank market for various maturities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Long-term bond yield
structure:Code.common:Description: The return on investment for long-term debt securities, typically with maturities of ten years or more.

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary policy-related
structure:Code.common:Description: Pertaining to the actions and policies implemented by a central bank to control the money supply and interest rates in an economy.

structure:Code.common:Name: Money market
structure:Code.common:Description: The market for short-term debt securities and financial instruments, typically with maturities of less than one year.

structure:Code.common:Name: Money market, maximum
structure:Code.common:Description: The highest interest rate offered in the money market for short-term debt instruments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Money market, minimum
structure:Code.common:Description: The lowest interest rate offered in the money market for short-term debt instruments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Monthly stock returns (measured as declines)
structure:Code.common:Description: The performance of stocks on a monthly basis, specifically measured by declines in value. One unit is equivalent to one standard deviation of standardized variable.

structure:Code.common:Name: Policy-related interest rate
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates set by central banks as part of their monetary policy to influence economic activity.

structure:Code.common:Name: Policy-related interest rate, percentage point difference in scenario (data from Modeling unit)
structure:Code.common:Description: The percentage point difference in the policy-related interest rate under various economic scenarios, based on data from a modeling unit.

structure:Code.common:Name: Real long-term bond yield
structure:Code.common:Description: The yield on long-term bonds adjusted for inflation.

structure:Code.common:Name: Real short-term deposit rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate on short-term deposits adjusted for inflation.

structure:Code.common:Name: Refinancing rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate at which existing debt can be replaced with new debt.

structure:Code.common:Name: Repurchase agreement rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate charged on repurchase agreements.

structure:Code.common:Name: Reverse repurchase agreement rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate charged on reverse repurchase agreements.

structure:Code.common:Name: Risk-free interest rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The theoretical rate of return on an investment with no credit risk, typically proxied by the yield on short-term government securities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Savings rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate paid by banks on savings accounts.

structure:Code.common:Name: SDR interest rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate applicable to Special Drawing Rights (SDRs), an international type of monetary reserve currency created by the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

structure:Code.common:Name: Short-term interest rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate on debt securities or financial instruments with maturities of less than one year.

structure:Code.common:Name: Three month interest rates
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rates applicable to debt securities or financial instruments with a maturity of three months.

structure:Code.common:Name: Treasury bills, 3-months
structure:Code.common:Description: The return on investment for short-term U.S. government debt securities with a maturity of three months.

structure:Code.common:Name: Treasury-EuroDollar spread (TED) or interbank spread
structure:Code.common:Description: The difference between the interest rates on short-term U.S. government debt (Treasury bills) and Eurodollar deposits (LIBOR). One unit is equivalent to one standard deviation of standardized variable.

structure:Code.common:Name: 6-month London interbank offered rate (LIBOR)
structure:Code.common:Description: Historical benchmark interest rate reflecting the estimated cost of unsecured borrowing for a six-month maturity, based on submissions from major banks in the London interbank market.

structure:Code.common:Name: Fixed rate
structure:Code.common:Description: An interest rate that remains unchanged for the entire term of a loan or investment, regardless of movements in market interest rates.

structure:Code.common:Name: Bilateral rates
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates agreed upon directly between two parties, typically in a large financial transaction or between a bank and a large corporation.

structure:Code.common:Name: London Eurodollar deposit rate, three-month
structure:Code.common:Description: A benchmark interest rate reflecting the rate at which banks are willing to lend U.S. dollar–denominated deposits (Eurodollars) to other banks in the London market for a three-month maturity.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro Area rates, new business: loans, consumer credit and other, households
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on new loan contracts to households in the Euro area for consumer credit and other purposes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Government bond yields, minimum
structure:Code.common:Description: The lowest observed yield among government bonds over a specified period or across a defined set of maturities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Variable rate
structure:Code.common:Description: An interest rate on a loan or security that varies over time in line with a specified benchmark interest rate or index.

structure:Code.common:Name: Policy-related interest rate for specific countries
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates set by central banks as part of their monetary policy to influence economic activity for a specific group of countries.

structure:Code.common:Name: US Federal Reserve Fund's target rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The US Federal Reserve's target rate, also known as the federal funds rate, is the interest rate that commercial banks charge each other for overnight loans of reserves.

structure:Code.common:Name: Repurchase agreement rate (Repo rate)
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate applied to repurchase agreements, under which securities are sold with a commitment to repurchase them at a later date.

structure:Code.common:Name: 6-month London interbank offered interest rate (LIBOR), real
structure:Code.common:Description: The 6-month LIBOR, adjusted for inflation, to reflect constant purchasing power. This is typically calculated by subtracting the expected inflation rate from the nominal LIBOR rate.

structure:Code.common:Name: Short-term CD interest rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate applicable to certificates of deposit with short-term maturities, typically up to one year.

structure:Code.common:Name: Government bonds yields medium and long term
structure:Code.common:Description: The market rates of return on medium- and long-term debt securities issued by a government, expressing the annual income generated by a bond relative to its current market price.

structure:Code.common:Name: Government bonds yields short-term
structure:Code.common:Description: The market rates of return on short-term debt securities issued by a government, expressing the annual income generated by a bond relative to its current market price.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro Area Rates, New Business, Loans, Non-financial Corporations, Other Than Bank Overdrafts, Over EUR 1 Million, Floating Rate and up to 1 Year
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on new loan contracts to non-financial corporations in the Euro area, excluding bank overdrafts, with loan amounts over EUR 1 million and with floating rates or an initial rate fixation period of up to one year.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro Area Rates, Outstanding Amounts, Deposits, Non-Financial Corporations, Repos
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on outstanding deposit positions of non-financial corporations in the Euro area arising from repurchase agreements (repos).

structure:Code.common:Name: 1-month London interbank offered rate (LIBOR)
structure:Code.common:Description: Historical benchmark interest rate reflecting the estimated cost of unsecured borrowing for a one-month maturity, based on submissions from major banks in the London interbank market.

structure:Code.common:Name: 1-year London interbank offered rate (LIBOR)
structure:Code.common:Description: Historical benchmark interest rate reflecting the estimated cost of unsecured borrowing for a one-year maturity, based on submissions from major banks in the London interbank market.

structure:Code.common:Name: 6-month London interbank offered rate (LIBOR)
structure:Code.common:Description: Historical benchmark interest rate reflecting the estimated cost of unsecured borrowing for a six-month maturity, based on submissions from major banks in the London interbank market.

structure:Code.common:Name: Overnight London interbank offered rate (LIBOR)
structure:Code.common:Description: Historical benchmark interest rate reflecting the estimated cost of unsecured overnight borrowing, based on submissions from major banks in the London interbank market.

structure:Code.common:Name: Rate of remuneration
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate paid on funds or balances held with an institution.

structure:Code.common:Name: Treasury bills yield
structure:Code.common:Description: The yield on short-term U.S. government debt securities with maturities of up to one year.

structure:Code.common:Name: Primary credit rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate charged by a central bank on primary credit extended to eligible depository institutions, typically through its standing lending facility.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro area rates: Deposits
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on deposit contracts with credit institutions in the Euro area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro area rates: Loans other than bank overdrafts, Over EUR 1 Million
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on loans other than bank overdrafts in the Euro area, with loan amounts exceeding EUR 1 million.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro Area rates: Loans, consumer credit and other
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on loans for consumer credit and other purposes in the Euro area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro area rates: Loans
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on loans in the Euro area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro Area Rates: Deposits, Repos
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on deposit positions arising from repurchase agreements (repos) in the Euro area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Harmonized Euro area rates: Deposits agreed maturity
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest rates on deposits with an agreed maturity in the Euro area.

structure:Code.common:Name: Government securities: Treasury bills yields
structure:Code.common:Description: The yields on short-term government debt securities (Treasury bills), typically with maturities of up to one year.

structure:Code.common:Name: Money market rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The market for short-term debt securities and financial instruments, typically with maturities of less than one year.

structure:Code.common:Name: London Eurodollar deposit rate
structure:Code.common:Description: A benchmark interest rate reflecting the rate at which banks are willing to lend U.S. dollar–denominated deposits (Eurodollars) to other banks in the London market.

structure:Code.common:Name: Interbank rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The interest rate at which banks lend funds to one another in the interbank market.

structure:Code.common:Name: Government securities
structure:Code.common:Description: Debt securities issued by a government to finance its operations and manage public debt.

structure:Code.common:Name: Government bonds
structure:Code.common:Description: Long-term government debt securities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Ukraine National Definition, Refinancing Rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The policy interest rate set by the National Bank of Ukraine, applied to its refinancing operations and serving as the key benchmark rate for monetary policy.

structure:Code.common:Name: Ukraine Other Rates, Treasury Bills
structure:Code.common:Description: Yields on short-term government debt securities (Treasury bills) issued by Ukraine.

structure:Code.common:Name: Ukraine PFTS Index Oct 1, 1997 EOM
structure:Code.common:Description: A Ukrainian equity market price index tracking the performance of selected listed shares, with a base value of 100 as of October 1, 1997, measured at end-of-month values.

structure:Codelist.common:Name: Security Classification
structure:Codelist.common:Description: This codelist designates the level of sensitivity or confidentiality associated with data, dictating the protective measures required for its handling, storage, and transmission.

structure:Code.common:Name: Public or Unrestricted
structure:Code.common:Description: Information that has been published in full by the Fund and has been approved to be made available inside and outside the Fund without restriction is “Public” or “Unclassified.”

structure:Code.common:Name: For official use only
structure:Code.common:Description: Information that is intended for all staff, without restriction, and in some cases, may be shared with national officials or other authorized individuals or institutions must be classified “For Official Use Only.” This may be information not authorized for public use but to which staff members may have access without demonstrating a particular direct interest in the matter in question. Such information must be marked accordingly when necessary to avoid being mistaken for unclassified information.

structure:Code.common:Name: Confidential
structure:Code.common:Description: Information that is sensitive and to which access needs to be confined to those with a need to know about the matter in question must be classified “Confidential.” Given the desirability of broad dissemination of information within the Fund and of simplicity in the design of information handling systems, this classification should be used sparingly.

structure:Code.common:Name: Strictly Confidential
structure:Code.common:Description: Information to which access is to be limited to those having a strict need to know and which would not be adequately protected by the Confidential classification shall be classified “Strictly Confidential.” The classification “Strictly Confidential” should be used only exceptionally for information of the highest sensitivity. For example, Crown Jewels information must be classified as Strictly Confidential.

structure:Code.common:Name: Personal and Confidential
structure:Code.common:Description: Information that is both "Personal" and "Confidential." Information that is sensitive and to which access needs to be confined to those with a need to know about the matter in question must be classified “Confidential.” Given the desirability of broad dissemination of information within the Fund and of simplicity in the design of information handling systems, this classification should be used sparingly.

structure:Code.common:Name: Personal and Strictly Confidential
structure:Code.common:Description: Information that is both "Personal" and "Strictly Confidential." Information to which access is to be limited to those having a strict need to know and which would not be adequately protected by the Confidential classification shall be classified “Strictly Confidential.” The classification “Strictly Confidential” should be used only exceptionally for information of the highest sensitivity.

structure:Codelist.common:Name: Valuation
structure:Codelist.common:Description: This codelist defines refers to the rules and conventions used for recording monetary flows and stocks in macroeconomic statistics. Standard national accounts valuations include the basic price (what the seller receives) and the purchaser's price (what the purchaser pays). The purchaser's price is the basic price, plus taxes less subsidies on products, plus invoiced transportation and insurance services, plus distribution margin. International trade in goods considers the free on board (fob) price and cost-insurance-freight price, among others. Other valuation types include prices used in financial markets (e.g., buy and sell prices).

structure:Code.common:Name: Nominal value
structure:Code.common:Description: Outstanding amount that at any moment in time the debtor owes to the creditor. It reflects the funds originally advanced, plus any subsequent advances, plus interest that has accrued, less any repayments (2016 MFSMCG definition).

structure:Code.common:Name: Market value
structure:Code.common:Description: The price at which an asset would change hands if it sold on the open market. Market prices for transactions are defined as amounts of money that willing buyers pay to acquire something from willing sellers; the exchanges are made between independent parties and on the basis of commercial considerations only, sometimes called “at arm’s length.”

structure:Code.common:Name: Face value
structure:Code.common:Description: The amount of principal to be repaid (for example, the redemption amount of a bond). Sometimes called initial contractual value, for loans, the face value is the original amount of the loan as stated in the loan contract. If the loan is not fully disbursed, then the face value will include future disbursements, just as the face value of a zero-coupon bond includes interest that has not yet accrued.

structure:Code.common:Name: Book value
structure:Code.common:Description: Valuation used in business accounts, generally referring to the value recorded in the enterprise records. Book values may have different meanings because their values are influenced by the timing of acquisition, company takeovers, frequency of revaluations and tax and other regulations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Fair value
structure:Code.common:Description: Valuation that reflects the market-equivalent value of an asset or liability. It is defined as the price at which an asset could be exchanged, or a liability settled, between knowledgeable, willing parties in an arm's-length transaction.

structure:Code.common:Name: Factor cost
structure:Code.common:Description: Gross value added at factor cost is derived by subtracting "other taxes, less subsidies, on production" from gross value added at basic prices.

structure:Code.common:Name: Cost insurance freight (CIF)
structure:Code.common:Description: The c.i.f. price (i.e. cost, insurance and freight price) is the price of a good delivered at the frontier of the importing country, including any insurance and freight charges incurred to that point, or the price of a service delivered to a resident, before the payment of any import duties or other taxes on imports or trade and transport margins within the country.

structure:Code.common:Name: Free on board (FOB)
structure:Code.common:Description: The f.o.b. price (free on board price) of exports and imports of goods is the market value of the goods at the point of uniform valuation, (the customs frontier of the economy from which they are exported). It is equal to the c.i.f. price less the costs of transportation and insurance charges, between the customs frontier of the exporting (importing) country and that of the importing (exporting) country.

structure:Code.common:Name: Fixed rate, face value
structure:Code.common:Description: A debt instrument with a fixed interest rate and valued at its face value (the amount to be repaid).

structure:Code.common:Name: Fixed rate, nominal value
structure:Code.common:Description: A debt instrument with a fixed interest rate and valued at its nominal value (the original issue price).

structure:Code.common:Name: Variable rate, face value
structure:Code.common:Description: A debt instrument with a variable interest rate and valued at its face value.

structure:Code.common:Name: Variable rate, nominal value
structure:Code.common:Description: A debt instrument with a variable interest rate and valued at its nominal value.

structure:Code.common:Name: Cash basis
structure:Code.common:Description: Recording of flows at the time the cash is received or disbursed.

structure:Code.common:Name: Previous year's replacement costs
structure:Code.common:Description: The cost to replace an asset in the previous year, used for valuation purposes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Current replacement cost
structure:Code.common:Description: Valuation method also known as current cost accounting, representing the cost to replace an asset at current prices.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gold at market price
structure:Code.common:Description: Gold at market price

structure:Code.common:Name: National valuation
structure:Code.common:Description: National valuation

structure:Code.common:Name: Official gold price
structure:Code.common:Description: Official gold price

structure:Code.common:Name: Accrual basis
structure:Code.common:Description: Recording of flows and changes in positions at the time economic value is created, transformed, exchanged, transferred or extinguished (which is not necessarily when cash or its equivalent is received or paid).

structure:Code.common:Name: Net market to market value
structure:Code.common:Description: Net mark-to-market value is the current value of an asset or portfolio after accounting for gains and losses based on market prices.

structure:Code.common:Name: Not Applicable
structure:Code.common:Description: Not Applicable

structure:Code.common:Name: Not Available
structure:Code.common:Description: Not Available

structure:Code.common:Name: Market rate
structure:Code.common:Description: Market rate is the prevailing interest rate or price at which financial instruments, goods, or services are traded in the open market based on supply and demand

structure:Code.common:Name: Commitments Basis
structure:Code.common:Description: In the commitments basis of recording, flows are recorded when an institutional unit has committed itself to a transaction.

structure:Code.common:Name: Due-for-Payments Basis
structure:Code.common:Description: In the due-for-payment basis of recording, flows that give rise to cash payments are recorded at the latest times they can be paid without incurring additional charges or penalties or, if sooner, when the cash payment is made.

structure:Code.common:Name: Mixed Basis

structure:Code.common:Name: Net incurrence of liabilities

structure:Code.common:Name: End-of-period exchange rate
structure:Code.common:Description: The end-of-period exchange rate refers to the exchange rate between two currencies at the end of a specific accounting or reporting period. This is typically the last business day of the month, quarter, or year.

This code covers both persons living in a same-sex marriage as well as in an opposite-sex marriage. This code excludes legally separated persons.
Ce code couvre les personnes vivant dans un mariage homosexuel ainsi que dans un mariage hétérosexuel. Ce code exclut les personnes légalement séparées.

Este código cubre tanto a las personas que viven en un matrimonio entre personas del mismo sexo como a las que viven en un matrimonio entre personas de distinto sexo. Este código excluye a las personas legalmente separadas.
此代码涵盖同性婚姻和异性婚姻中的双方。此代码不包括合法分居的人。

Этот код включает лиц, чей брак был расторгнут смертью партнера и которые не вступили в повторный брак или зарегистрированное партнерство.
Este código inclui pessoas cujo casamento terminou com a morte do parceiro e que não voltaram a casar ou em união de facto registrada.
このコードには、配偶者の死亡により婚姻が終了し、再婚または登録パートナーシップをしていない人が含まれます。
This code includes persons whose marriage ended with the death of the partner and who are not remarried or in a registered partnership.
Ce code inclut les personnes dont le mariage a pris fin par le décès du partenaire et qui ne sont pas remariées ou en partenariat enregistré.
Este código incluye a las personas cuyo matrimonio terminó con la muerte de la pareja y que no se han vuelto a casar ni están en una pareja de hecho registrada.
此代码包括因伴侣去世而婚姻终止且未再婚或登记伴侣关系的人。

Este código incluye a las personas cuyo matrimonio terminó con un procedimiento de divorcio y que no se han vuelto a casar ni están en una pareja de hecho registrada.
此代码包括因离婚程序而婚姻终止且未再婚或登记伴侣关系的人。

Этот код включает лиц, которые находятся в разводе: они все еще состоят в браке, но "официально" разлучены.

This code includes persons who are separated: they are still married, but "officially" separated.
Ce code inclut les personnes séparées : elles sont toujours mariées, mais séparées « officiellement ».
Este código incluye a las personas que están separadas: todavía están casadas, pero "oficialmente" separadas.
此代码包括分居的人：他们仍然结婚，但“正式”分居。

structure:Code.common:Name: شخص في شراكة مسجلة
Лицо, состоящее в зарегистрированном партнерстве

在册伴侣关系人士
structure:Code.common:Description: يشمل هذا الرمز الأشخاص الذين يعيشون في شراكة مسجلة من جنسين مختلفين وكذلك في شراكة مسجلة من نفس الجنس. تشمل الشراكات المسجلة أيضًا الزيجات العرفية التي تعتبر قانونية وملزمة بموجب القانون الوطني. يستثني هذا الرمز الأشخاص الذين تم حل شراكتهم المسجلة بشكل قانوني.

Этот код охватывает как лиц, живущих в зарегистрированном партнерстве с лицом противоположного пола, так и в зарегистрированном партнерстве с лицом того же пола. Зарегистрированные партнерства также включают традиционные союзы, которые являются законными и обязательными в соответствии с национальным законодательством. Этот код исключает лиц, чье зарегистрированное партнерство было юридически расторгнуто.

Este código abrange tanto as pessoas que vivem em união de facto registrada entre pessoas de sexo diferente como as que vivem em união de facto registrada entre pessoas do mesmo sexo. As uniões de facto registradas também incluem as uniões consuetudinárias que são legais e vinculativas ao abrigo da lei nacional. Este código exclui as pessoas cuja união de facto registrada foi legalmente dissolvida.
このコードは、異性登録パートナーシップと、同性登録パートナーシップの両方の当事者を対象としています。登録パートナーシップには、国内法で合法かつ拘束力のある慣習的な組合も含まれます。このコードは、登録パートナーシップが法的に解消された人を除外します。

This code covers both persons living in an opposite-sex registered partnership as well as in a same-sex registered partnership. Registered partnerships also include customary unions that are legal and binding under national law. This code excludes persons whose registered partnership was legally dissolved.

Ce code couvre les personnes vivant dans un partenariat enregistré hétérosexuel ainsi que dans un partenariat enregistré homosexuel. Les partenariats enregistrés comprennent également les unions coutumières qui sont légales et contraignantes en vertu du droit national. Ce code exclut les personnes dont le partenariat enregistré a été légalement dissous.

Este código cubre tanto a las personas que viven en una pareja de hecho registrada entre personas de distinto sexo como a las que viven en una pareja de hecho registrada entre personas del mismo sexo. Las parejas de hecho registradas también incluyen las uniones consuetudinarias que son legales y vinculantes en virtud del derecho nacional. Este código excluye a las personas cuya pareja de hecho registrada se disolvió legalmente.
此代码涵盖异性登记伴侣关系和同性登记伴侣关系中的双方。登记伴侣关系还包括根据国家法律具有法律约束力的习惯结合。此代码不包括登记伴侣关系已合法解除的人。

Personne dont le partenariat enregistré a pris fin par le décès du partenaire
Persona cuya unión registrada terminó con la muerte del compañero/a
登记伴侣关系因伴侣死亡而终止的人士
structure:Code.common:Description: يشمل هذا الرمز الأشخاص الذين انتهت شراكتهم المسجلة بوفاة الشريك ولم يتزوجوا مرة أخرى أو في شراكة مسجلة.
Этот код включает лиц, чье зарегистрированное партнерство было расторгнуто смертью партнера и которые не вступили в повторный брак или зарегистрированное партнерство.
Este código inclui pessoas cuja união de facto registrada terminou com a morte do parceiro e que não voltaram a casar ou em união de facto registrada.
このコードには、パートナーの死亡により登録パートナーシップが終了し、再婚または登録パートナーシップをしていない人が含まれます。
This code includes persons whose registered partnership ended with the death of the partner and who are not remarried or in a registered partnership.
Ce code inclut les personnes dont le partenariat enregistré a pris fin par le décès du partenaire et qui ne sont pas remariées ou en partenariat enregistré.
Este código incluye a las personas cuya pareja de hecho registrada terminó con la muerte de la pareja y que no se han vuelto a casar ni están en una pareja de hecho registrada.
此代码包括因伴侣去世而登记伴侣关系终止且未再婚或登记伴侣关系的人。

structure:Code.common:Name: شخص تم حل شراكته المسجلة قانونيًا
Лицо, зарегистрированное партнерство которого было расторгнуто в судебном порядке
Pessoa cuja união de facto/registada foi legalmente dissolvida
登録されたパートナーシップが法的に解消された人
Person whose registered partnership was legally dissolved
Personne dont le partenariat enregistré a été légalement dissous
Persona cuya unión registrada fue legalmente disuelta
登记伴侣关系依法解除的人士
structure:Code.common:Description: يشمل هذا الرمز الأشخاص الذين انتهت شراكتهم المسجلة بإجراء قانوني ولم يتزوجوا مرة أخرى أو في شراكة مسجلة.
Этот код включает лиц, чье зарегистрированное партнерство было расторгнуто в результате судебного разбирательства и которые не вступили в повторный брак или зарегистрированное партнерство.
Este código inclui pessoas cuja união de facto registrada terminou com um processo legal e que não voltaram a casar ou em união de facto registrada.
このコードには、法的手続きにより登録パートナーシップが終了し、再婚または登録パートナーシップをしていない人が含まれます。
This code includes persons whose registered partnership ended with a legal procedure and who are not remarried or in a registered partnership.
Ce code inclut les personnes dont le partenariat enregistré a pris fin par une procédure légale et qui ne sont pas remariées ou en partenariat enregistré.
Este código incluye a las personas cuya pareja de hecho registrada terminó con un procedimiento legal y que no se han vuelto a casar ni están en una pareja de hecho registrada.
此代码包括因法律程序而登记伴侣关系终止且未再婚或登记伴侣关系的人。

structure:Codelist.common:Name: Sex
structure:Codelist.common:Description: This codelist represents a set of codes and definitions that classify an individual's sex based on assigned sex at birth and/or biological attributes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Female
structure:Code.common:Description: Female sex assigned at birth.

structure:Code.common:Name: Male
structure:Code.common:Description: Male sex assigned at birth.

structure:Code.common:Name: Intersex
structure:Code.common:Description: An individual having innate different sex traits, such as chromosomes, gonads, or genitals, that fall outside of the typical male/female binary and/or have male and female sex traits.

structure:Code.common:Name: X
structure:Code.common:Description: A category for non-binary individuals, gender non_x0002_conforming individuals, and other persons who do not wish to define themselves in terms of binary sex categories.

structure:Code.common:Name: Not applicable
structure:Code.common:Description: Used in response to a question or a request for information that does not apply to the circumstances of the unit being surveyed. This concept is to be understood as meaning "statistically not applicable"; i.e. _Z is to be used only for statistical purposes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Unknown
structure:Code.common:Description: Failure to obtain a measurement (e.g. non response, no data available, information not known by the respondent unit, etc.).

structure:Code.common:Name: Total
structure:Code.common:Description: Used for expressing totals.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other
structure:Code.common:Description: Used to cover residual information not contained in other categories of the code list (in some contexts, e.g. classifications, referred to as n.e.s., not elsewhere specified, n.e.c., not elsewhere classified, etc.)

structure:Code.common:Name: Non response
structure:Code.common:Description: Failure to obtain a measurement on one or more study variables for one or more elements in a survey.

structure:Codelist.common:Name: NA Stocks, Transactions, Other Flows
structure:Codelist.common:Description: This codelist represents the different classifications of data items used in the System of National Accounts (SNA) framework, distinguishing between stocks (levels at a point in time), transactions (changes over a period), and other flows.

structure:Code.common:Name: Grants in cash
structure:Code.common:Description: Grants provided in monetary form.

structure:Code.common:Name: Grants in kind
structure:Code.common:Description: Grants provided as goods or services rather than cash.

structure:Code.common:Name: Taxes on property
structure:Code.common:Description: Taxes levied on ownership or transfer of property (land, buildings, etc.).

structure:Code.common:Name: Recurrent taxes on wealth: taxes on property
structure:Code.common:Description: Taxes levied regularly on the value of wealth, including property.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other recurrent taxes on property: taxes on property
structure:Code.common:Description: Recurrent property taxes not classified as wealth taxes, such as annual property taxes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total employment
structure:Code.common:Description: The total number of employed persons.

structure:Code.common:Name: Transactions in financial assets and liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: All transactions involving changes in financial assets (e.g., stocks, bonds) and liabilities (e.g., loans).

structure:Code.common:Name: Factor Income
structure:Code.common:Description: Income earned from factors of production (labor, capital).

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross operating balance
structure:Code.common:Description: The surplus or deficit from production activities before deducting interest and other property income.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net operating balance
structure:Code.common:Description: The gross operating balance less consumption of fixed capital (depreciation).

structure:Code.common:Name: Net lending (+) / net borrowing (-) [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: The difference between total revenue and total expenditure. A positive value indicates net lending; a negative value indicates net borrowing.

structure:Code.common:Name: Primary net lending (+) / net borrowing (-) [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: Net lending/borrowing excluding interest payments and receipts.

structure:Code.common:Name: Implicit transfers resulting from concessional interest rates
structure:Code.common:Description: The benefit received by a borrower when receiving a below-market interest rate loan.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net cash inflow from financial activities
structure:Code.common:Description: The net change in cash resulting from financing activities (e.g., borrowing, issuing equity).

structure:Code.common:Name: Compensation of employees excluding for own-account capital formation
structure:Code.common:Description: Payments to employees (wages, salaries, social contributions) excluding those related to own-account capital formation.

structure:Code.common:Name: Wages and salaries excluding for own-account capital formation [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: Payments to employees in cash and in kind, excluding those related to own-account capital formation.

structure:Code.common:Name: Wages and salaries in cash excluding for own-account capital formation [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: Payments to employees in monetary form, excluding those related to own-account capital formation.

structure:Code.common:Name: Wages and salaries in kind excluding for own-account capital formation [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: Payments to employees in the form of goods or services, excluding those related to own-account capital formation.

structure:Code.common:Name: Employers' social contributions, excluding for own-account capital formation [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: Payments made by employers to social security schemes on behalf of their employees, excluding those related to own-account capital formation.

structure:Code.common:Name: Employers' actual social contributions, excluding for own-account capital formation [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: Social contributions employers are legally obliged to pay, excluding those related to own-account capital formation.

structure:Code.common:Name: Employers' imputed social contributions, excluding for own-account capital formation [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: The value of social benefits provided directly by employers to their employees, considered as contributions, excluding those related to own-account capital formation.

structure:Code.common:Name: Subsidies other than for own-account capital formation
structure:Code.common:Description: Payments made by governments to producers to lower their production costs, excluding those related to own-account capital formation.

structure:Code.common:Name: Property income before FISIM allocation, excluding investment income payable on pension entitlements [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: Income received from ownership of assets (interest, dividends, rent), before adjusting for FISIM (Financial Intermediation Services Indirectly Measured), excluding investment income payable on pension entitlements.

structure:Code.common:Name: Property income other than interest, excluding investment income payable on pension entitlements [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: Property income excluding interest (e.g. dividends, rent), excluding investment income payable on pension entitlements.

structure:Code.common:Name: Social contributions, excluding employment related schemes' pension contribution [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: Payments made by individuals and employers to social security schemes, excluding pension contributions related to employment schemes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Social security contributions: employee contributions
structure:Code.common:Description: Contributions paid by employees to social security systems.

structure:Code.common:Name: Social security contributions: employer contributions
structure:Code.common:Description: Contributions paid by employers to social security systems.

structure:Code.common:Name: Social security contributions: self-employed or nonemployed contributions
structure:Code.common:Description: Contributions paid by self-employed or non-employed individuals to social security systems.

structure:Code.common:Name: Social security contributions: unallocable contributions
structure:Code.common:Description: Social security contributions that cannot be attributed to specific groups (employees, employers, etc.).

structure:Code.common:Name: Other social contributions
structure:Code.common:Description: Social contributions outside of standard social security arrangements.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other social contributions, employee contributions
structure:Code.common:Description: Employee contributions to social schemes outside regular social security.

structure:Code.common:Name: Social benefits in cash, excluding other social insurance pension benefits [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: Cash payments from social security schemes to individuals, excluding pensions from other social insurance schemes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Social benefits, excluding other social insurance pension benefits and social transfers in kind - non-market production [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: All social benefits excluding pensions from other social insurance schemes and social transfers in kind provided by non-market producers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Employer social benefits, excluding pension benefits [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: Social benefits provided directly by employers to employees, excluding pension benefits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Premiums of nonlife insurance schemes other than standardized guarantees
structure:Code.common:Description: Premiums paid for non-life insurance policies, excluding those related to standardized guarantees.

structure:Code.common:Name: Miscellaneous current transfers: other than fines, penalties, and forfeits
structure:Code.common:Description: Current transfers not elsewhere classified, excluding fines, penalties, and forfeits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Premiums, fees, and current claims
structure:Code.common:Description: Payments related to insurance and guarantee schemes, including premiums, fees, and claims payments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Premiums, fees, and claims related to nonlife insurance and standardized guarantee schemes
structure:Code.common:Description: Payments related to non-life insurance and standardized guarantee schemes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Current transfers not elsewhere classified
structure:Code.common:Description: Current transfers that don't fit into other defined categories.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other taxes [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: Taxes not classified as taxes on income, profits and capital gains, social security contributions, payroll taxes, taxes on property, taxes on goods and services.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other taxes payable solely by business
structure:Code.common:Description: Taxes paid exclusively by businesses.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other taxes payable by other than business or unidentifiable
structure:Code.common:Description: Taxes paid by entities other than businesses or where the payer is not identifiable.

structure:Code.common:Name: Deficit-debt adjustment
structure:Code.common:Description: Adjustments made to reconcile the government deficit with the change in government debt.

structure:Code.common:Name: Time of recording and other differences in DDA analysis (ECB concept)
structure:Code.common:Description: Adjustments for differences in the timing of recording transactions and other discrepancies in deficit-debt adjustment analysis.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other expense [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: Government expenses not classified elsewhere.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other revenue [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: Government revenue not classified elsewhere.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total government expenditure [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: The total spending by government units.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total expense
structure:Code.common:Description: Total spending by government units, including consumption of fixed capital.

structure:Code.common:Name: Expense, excluding consumption of fixed capital
structure:Code.common:Description: Total spending by government units, excluding depreciation.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total government revenue [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: The total receipts of government units.

structure:Code.common:Name: Sales of goods and services
structure:Code.common:Description: Revenue from sales of goods and services by government units.

structure:Code.common:Name: Sales by market establishments
structure:Code.common:Description: Sales by government units operating as market producers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Use of goods and services
structure:Code.common:Description: The use of goods and services in production or final consumption.

structure:Code.common:Name: Consumption of fixed capital (use of fixed assets) [IMF GFSM definition]
structure:Code.common:Description: The decline in the value of fixed assets due to wear and tear, obsolescence, or accidental damage.

structure:Code.common:Name: Primary and secondary income
structure:Code.common:Description: The sum of primary income (from factors of production) and secondary income (current transfers).

structure:Code.common:Name: Primary income
structure:Code.common:Description: Income derived directly from the factors of production (labor, capital).

structure:Code.common:Name: Secondary income
structure:Code.common:Description: Income received through current transfers (e.g., social benefits, taxes).

structure:Code.common:Name: Secondary income: current transfers
structure:Code.common:Description: Redistribution of income through current transfers, such as taxes, social benefits, and other unrequited payments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Secondary income: other current transfers excluding personal transfers
structure:Code.common:Description: Current transfers excluding transfers between households (e.g., remittances), encompassing transfers between governments, businesses, and non-profit institutions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Inventories
structure:Code.common:Description: Stocks of goods held by producers for sale or further processing.

structure:Code.common:Name: Changes in positions other than transactions
structure:Code.common:Description: Changes in assets and liabilities not due to transactions, such as revaluations or other changes in volume.

structure:Code.common:Name: Economic disappearances of non-produced assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Reductions in the value or quantity of non-produced assets due to economic factors.

structure:Code.common:Name: Depletion of natural resources
structure:Code.common:Description: Reduction in the stock of natural resources due to extraction or use.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other economic disappearances of non-produced assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Other decreases in non-produced assets not due to depletion, such as write-offs.

structure:Code.common:Name: Changes in sector classification and structure
structure:Code.common:Description: Changes in the classification of institutional units to different sectors or changes in the structure of the economy.

structure:Code.common:Name: Changes in classification of assets and liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: Changes in the classification of assets and liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Revaluations / Nominal holding gains and losses
structure:Code.common:Description: Changes in the monetary value of assets and liabilities due to changes in prices.

structure:Code.common:Name: Neutral holding gains and losses
structure:Code.common:Description: Changes in value due to general inflation.

structure:Code.common:Name: Revaluations due to exchange rate changes
structure:Code.common:Description: Changes in value due to fluctuations in exchange rates.

structure:Code.common:Name: Revaluations due to other price changes
structure:Code.common:Description: Changes in value due to changes in specific asset prices.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other valuation effects of which due to issuance and redemption value
structure:Code.common:Description: Valuation effects specifically relating to the issuance and redemption values of financial instruments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other changes excluding revaluations
structure:Code.common:Description: Changes in assets and liabilities not due to transactions or revaluations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other volume changes in debt liabilities (K.3, K.4, K.5) (-)
structure:Code.common:Description: Changes in debt liabilities due to factors other than transactions, revaluations, or classification changes (e.g., debt write-offs).

structure:Code.common:Name: Closing balance sheet / positions / stocks
structure:Code.common:Description: The value of assets and liabilities at the end of a period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Labour productivity (per persons)
structure:Code.common:Description: Output per employed person.

structure:Code.common:Name: Opening balance sheet / positions / stocks
structure:Code.common:Description: The value of assets and liabilities at the beginning of a period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Changes in balance sheet / positions / stocks
structure:Code.common:Description: The net change in assets and liabilities over a period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Acquisitions less disposals of fixed assets: residential structures
structure:Code.common:Description: Net investment in residential buildings and dwellings.

structure:Code.common:Name: Acquisitions less disposals of fixed assets non-residential structures
structure:Code.common:Description: Net investment in non-residential buildings and structures (e.g., factories, offices).

structure:Code.common:Name: Acquisitions less disposals of non-produced assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Net investment in non-produced assets (e.g., land, mineral rights).

structure:Code.common:Name: Nominal Pre-tax profits
structure:Code.common:Description: Profits before taxes are deducted.

structure:Code.common:Name: Household saving ratio
structure:Code.common:Description: The proportion of household disposable income that is saved.

structure:Code.common:Name: Adjustment product taxes less subsidies
structure:Code.common:Description: Adjustments made to product taxes less subsidies to align with specific accounting principles.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total current expenditure
structure:Code.common:Description: Government spending on current operations (e.g., wages, goods and services).

structure:Code.common:Name: Primary current expenditure
structure:Code.common:Description: Current expenditure excluding interest payments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total current revenue
structure:Code.common:Description: Government receipts from current sources (e.g., taxes, social contributions).

structure:Code.common:Name: Social benefits other than social transfers in kind + social transfers in kind, purchased market production + subsidies payable + current taxes on income, wealth, etc. + other taxes on production + property income other than interest + other current transfers
structure:Code.common:Description: A combination of various current transactions including social benefits, subsidies, taxes, and property income.

structure:Code.common:Name: Interest, including flows on swaps and FRA's
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest payments and receipts, including those related to financial derivatives.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total tax receipts
structure:Code.common:Description: Total revenue collected from taxes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total receipts from taxes and social contributions after deduction of amounts assessed but unlikely to be collected
structure:Code.common:Description: Total tax and social contribution revenue adjusted for uncollectible amounts.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total receipts from taxes and social contributions (including imputed social contributions) after deduction of amounts assessed but unlikely to be collected
structure:Code.common:Description: Total tax and social contribution revenue including imputed contributions and adjusted for uncollectible amounts.

structure:Code.common:Name: Tax burden = total receipts from taxes and compulsory social contributions after deduction of amounts assessed but unlikely to be collected
structure:Code.common:Description: The proportion of the economy represented by tax and social contribution revenue, adjusted for uncollectible amounts.

structure:Code.common:Name: Memo: Difference between deliveries and corresponding cash payment (EDP concept)
structure:Code.common:Description: The difference between the value of goods/services delivered and the actual cash payments made.

structure:Code.common:Name: Intermediate consumption, other taxes on production, current taxes on income and wealth, etc., and adjustment for the change in net equity of households in pension funds reserves
structure:Code.common:Description: A combination of intermediate consumption, taxes, and adjustments related to pension funds.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other taxes on production, current taxes on income and wealth, etc. and adjustment for the change in net equity of households in pension funds reserves
structure:Code.common:Description: Similar to OEA, but potentially with a slightly different scope.

structure:Code.common:Name: Intermediate consumption + Other taxes on production + Current taxes on income, wealth, etc. + Adjustment for the change in pension entitlements
structure:Code.common:Description: A combination of intermediate consumption, taxes, and adjustments related to pension entitlements.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other taxes on production + Current taxes on income, wealth, etc. + Adjustment for the change in pension entitlements
structure:Code.common:Description: Similar to OEC, but potentially with a slightly different scope.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total impact of differences in definitions between ESA2010 and ESA95 on GNI
structure:Code.common:Description: The overall impact on Gross National Income (GNI) due to changes in statistical standards between ESA2010 and ESA95.

structure:Code.common:Name: Impact of differences in definitions between ESA2010 and ESA95 on GNI: R&D created by a market producer
structure:Code.common:Description: Specific impact on GNI due to the treatment of R&D produced by market producers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Impact of differences in definitions between ESA2010 and ESA95 on GNI: R&D created by a non-market producer
structure:Code.common:Description: Specific impact on GNI due to the treatment of R&D produced by non-market producers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Impact of differences in definitions between ESA2010 and ESA95 on GNI: Valuation of output for own final use for market producers
structure:Code.common:Description: Impact on GNI from changes in how market producers value output used for their own purposes.

structure:Code.common:Name: Impact of differences in definitions between ESA2010 and ESA95 on GNI: Non-life insurance - Output, claims due to catastrophes, and reinsurance
structure:Code.common:Description: Impact on GNI related to non-life insurance accounting, particularly concerning catastrophes and reinsurance.

structure:Code.common:Name: Impact of differences in definitions between ESA2010 and ESA95 on GNI: Weapon systems in government recognized as capital assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Impact on GNI due to the classification of weapon systems as capital assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Impact of differences in definitions between ESA2010 and ESA95 on GNI: Decommissioning costs for large capital assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Impact on GNI related to the accounting of decommissioning costs.

structure:Code.common:Name: Impact of differences in definitions between ESA2010 and ESA95 on GNI: Government, public and private sector classification
structure:Code.common:Description: Impact on GNI from changes in sector classification rules.

structure:Code.common:Name: Impact of differences in definitions between ESA2010 and ESA95 on GNI: Small tools
structure:Code.common:Description: Impact on GNI due to the treatment of small tools as assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Impact of differences in definitions between ESA2010 and ESA95 on GNI: VAT-based third EU own resource
structure:Code.common:Description: Impact on GNI related to the calculation of the VAT-based EU own resource.

structure:Code.common:Name: Impact of differences in definitions between ESA2010 and ESA95 on GNI: Index-linked debt instruments
structure:Code.common:Description: Impact on GNI from changes in the accounting for index-linked debt.

structure:Code.common:Name: Impact of differences in definitions between ESA2010 and ESA95 on GNI: Central Bank - allocation of output
structure:Code.common:Description: Impact on GNI related to the allocation of central bank output.

structure:Code.common:Name: Impact of differences in definitions between ESA2010 and ESA95 on GNI: Land improvements recognized as a separate asset
structure:Code.common:Description: Impact on GNI from recognizing land improvements as a separate asset class.

structure:Code.common:Name: Guarantee fees receivable
structure:Code.common:Description: Fees received for providing guarantees.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross disposable income minus final consumption expenditure
structure:Code.common:Description: The portion of disposable income remaining after households have spent on final consumption. This represents household saving.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total capital expenditure
structure:Code.common:Description: Government spending on investment in fixed assets (e.g., infrastructure, buildings).

structure:Code.common:Name: Member State's net revenue from pre-acceding programmes
structure:Code.common:Description: Net revenue received by a Member State from EU pre-accession programs.

structure:Code.common:Name: Current taxes on income, wealth, etc. plus other taxes on production plus property income other than interest plus other current transfers and adjustment for the change in pension entitlements
structure:Code.common:Description: A comprehensive measure of current government revenue, including taxes, property income (excluding interest), other transfers, and pension adjustments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other current revenue
structure:Code.common:Description: Government revenue from sources other than taxes on income/wealth, production, and property income.

structure:Code.common:Name: Current taxes on income, wealth, etc. plus other taxes on production plus property income other than interest plus other current transfers excluding current transfers to NPISH
structure:Code.common:Description: Similar to OOCE, but excluding current transfers to Non-Profit Institutions Serving Households (NPISH).

structure:Code.common:Name: Total government expenditure excluding: interest, calls on guarantees, capital injections recorded as capital transfers
structure:Code.common:Description: Government spending excluding debt interest payments, guarantee payments, and capital injections classified as capital transfers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total government expenditure excluding: interest, calls on guarantees, capital injections recorded as capital transfers, capital transfers recorded in the context of asset purchases
structure:Code.common:Description: Similar to OOE, but further excluding capital transfers related to asset purchases.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other revenue
structure:Code.common:Description: Revenue not classified elsewhere.

structure:Code.common:Name: Purchases
structure:Code.common:Description: Acquisitions of goods and services.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross disposable income - gross operating surplus and mixed income - compensation of employees - social contribution and social benefits, other than social transfer in kind - current taxes on income, wealth, etc.
